We are committed to bringing our customers the tastiest street food, using the freshest ingredients and most dedicated service. We want you to enjoy our food and we are obsessed with getting them right for you.

name: So Do Fun
description: Specializing in "Boiled Live Fish" as its signature dish, SO DO FUN is a popular Sichuan restaurant chain renowned for its "fresh ingredients prepared on-site." With just this one handcrafted boiled live fish dish, it has remained popular for 18 years, operating nearly 100 direct stores across China, Singapore, and Malaysia. For years, it has consistently ranked among the top three on regional Sichuan cuisine lists and dominated as the No. 1 popular Sichuan brand in various markets. It was listed on the "Dianping Must-Eat List" in 2018 and 2023. For 18 years, SODOFUN has used fresh ingredients.

name: So Do Fun
description: So Do Fun Sichuan Cuisine was founded in 2007 and is renowned for its signature dish — Boiled Live Fish. We use fresh, live ingredients prepared daily on-site, bringing the authentic taste of Sichuan to every table. For 18 years, So Do Fun has remained one of the most beloved Sichuan restaurants, consistently ranking as a top choice on local food charts. Today, we operate nearly 100 outlets across China, Singapore, and Malaysia, serving over one million bowls of boiled fish annually.

name: So Pho
description: So Pho's cuisine captures the true flavor of traditional Vietnamese cuisine like no other restaurant in Singapore. In So Pho, we offer wide range of food offerings from across Vietnam. Take your pick from spring rolls, to noodles and banh mi as well as other main dishes and desserts.

name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh
description: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh have come a long way from one food cart on the street. Yet their pushcart icon reminds us what they are about, an original Bak Kut Teh experience: tender, fall-off-the-bone pork ribs; hot, flavourful, spicy-peppery soup; a 1960s roadside dining ambience. At Song Fa, the heritage of Bak Kut Teh lives on in its truest sense.eritage of good old Bak Kut Teh in it's truest sense.

Now in Singapore, we continue this legacy with the same recipes, premium ingredients, and hospitality. Designed with traditional Hanok elements, our space blends modern city life with Korea’s timeless dining culture.

name: Soup Restaurant
description: Our origins may be traced back to 1991 when our first outlet was established in Smith Street. Our founders, Mok Yip Peng, Wong Wei Teck, Wong Chi Keong and Ho Hong Chin observed a surge in the popularity of Herbal Soups in Hong Kong, with the emergence of restaurants specialising in Herbal Soups. Inspired by this development, our founders were of the view that there would be a demand in Singapore for Herbal Soups and home-cooked dishes, especially by young professionals with limited access to home-cooked food.
opening_hours: Monday to Friday 11.30am to 2.30pm 5.30pm to 10pm Saturday, Sunday and Public Holiday 11.30am to 10pm

Go for the chicken kebabs if you’re new to Stuff’d, or if you’re looking for something even more filling, go for their Burritos!

description: Swee Heng 1989 Classic is a new brand born from the 1st Singapore full fledge halal bakery chain known as Swee Heng Bakery in the late 80s. Making its official debut at West Mall in 2014. Swee Heng 1989 Classic has since gained wide popularity and recognition from Singaporeans. Till date, we have opened a total of 27 outlets and 1 Bakery Cafes island wide. Holding on to the same promise made by Swee Heng Bakery, sharing our baking passion to all communities. Till now, we remain committed in using the finest ingredients gathered around the world to produce good quality and affordable products. Our vision is to become “Bakery of people, Bread for life”. We strive hard to make Swee Heng the Singapore Bakery that serves all communities.

name: TORI-Q
description: TORI-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated “Tare” (sauce) for enhanced flavours.

name: Tai Cheong Bakery
description: Tai Cheong Bakery was started in 1954 by egg tart Master Au Yeung’s uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. After taking over Tai Cheong Bakery, Au Yeung pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts, refining several other recipes using techniques he learned from his previous work in a hotel baking cakes. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street. The popularity of Tai Cheong remains till today.

name: Tai Chong Kok
description: At Tai Chong Kok, we have been making mooncakes and traditional Cantonese pastries the same way since 1935 - from scratch and by hand. For 3 generations we have used only premium ingredients to produce our authentic Cantonese confectionary. Tai Chong Kok mooncakes are renowned for their genuine taste of tradition. We are one of the very few bakeries left in Singapore that still produce our fresh lotus paste by hand using 100% pure lotus seeds with no preservatives added and these fill mooncakes that are formed in the same traditional wooden moulds used at the original Sago Street store in Chinatown more than 89 years ago. Today, you can still bring home our mooncakes in stringed brown paper bags, just as our forefathers did in pre-war Singapore. Tai Chong Kok is also famed for our traditional Nian Gao (Chinese New Year's cake) that are made using 100% pure glutinous rice. Tai Chong Kok products are handmade and baked daily with no preservative added in Singapore using time-honoured recipes and quality ingredients with full conformity to Stringent Quality Standards of SFA, HACCP and BizSafe.

description: Tiong Bahru Jian Bo Shui Kueh is a home-grown heritage brand selling traditional local food. The brand diligently adheres to time-tested recipes for 2 consecutive years and they have been awarded the highly acclaimed Bib Gourmand in MICHELIN Guide Singapore.

name: Tip Top Curry Puff

name: Toast Box
description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is a Singaporean contemporary coffee chain rooted in the recreation of Nanyang coffee and toast culture popular during the 1960s and 70s. Step inside and be greeted by the fragrance of coffee made from freshly-ground caramelised coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites. The enticing aroma of brewed coffee and flavourful local delights infuse vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the nostalgic taste of a bygone era. In addition to preserving the taste of Nanyang at home, Toast Box is now also brewing in Hong Kong, Jakarta, Johor Bahru, Kuala Lumpur, and Chinese-Taipei, sharing the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: Toast Box
description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.

description: Tokyo Shokudo is a “No Pork No Lard” Japanese dining concept offering an extensive selection of popular and trendy Japanese food like Ramen, Tendon (tempura donburi), Shabu Shabu, Sukiyaki and Rice Sets. Look forward to three exciting Ramen soup bases – Original, Tom Yam and Spicy! Tendon is from award-winning Chef Akimitsu, a five-time gold medalist at Japan Donburi Awards.

name: Tonkatsu ENbiton
description: The very essence of our brand name, 'EN' representing a gathering place, and 'Biton' meaning beautiful, perfectly captures the soul of our restaurant. Tonkatsu ENbiton, a destination for authentic tonkatsu experiences. We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest pork from renowned farms in Japan and around the world, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavour in every dish. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every cut of pork we serve maintains the highest standards of quality and flavour. Our skilled chefs meticulously prepare each tonkatsu dish to perfection, using airy, light, and crispy panko (bread crumbs) imported from Saitama Prefecture of Japan for that delightful texture. Whether you're indulging in our tonkatsu or exploring our diverse menu of signature dishes like the A4/A5 Miyazaki gyukatsu, black curry ramen, sandos, or a simple take-out bento, expect a culinary journey celebrating the rich and complex flavours of Japanese cuisine

name: Tonkatsu by Ma Maison
description: Ma Maison, which is French for “my house”, is one of the most well-loved restaurant chain offering Western- Japanese fusion cuisine. One of the main draws is its irresistibly good pork cutlet—available as Rosu (pork loin) Katsu or the leaner Hire (pork fillet) Katsu—which undergoes an aging and marinating process before it is breaded and deep-fried. The pork cutlets are served in sets with rice, shredded cabbage, and tonjiru (miso soup with pork) and pickles—all refillable. To enjoy the best of both land and sea, order the premium Unagi Tonkatsu Kamado Set comprising premium charcoal-grilled unagi from Isshiki in Aichi prefecture, kamado- style rice cooked in a traditional Japanese earthen pot, pickles, nyumen (soup noodles) and a choice of Rosu or Hire Katsu.
opening_hours: Monday to Friday 11am to 2.30pm ; 5pm to 9.30pm Saturday to Sunday 11am to 9.30pm

name: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen
description: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen is a popular authentic Japanese hot stone ramen with an entertaining twist, with portions and a variety of menu good for sharing and for fun family dining.

name: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen
description: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen is a popular authentic Japanese hot stone ramen with an entertaining twist, with portions and a variety of menu good for sharing and for fun family dining. The dish is prepared in a 350°C hot stone bowl, where thick noodles and vegetables are placed before hot soup is poured over them, creating a dramatic steam effect that resembles a volcanic eruption. The " Okoge "  that forms when ingredients touch the hot stone, adds a fragrant aroma and delightful texture.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 10pm (Last Order at 9.30pm)

name: Tori-Q
description: Tori-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. name: Twelve Cupcakes
description: Satisfy your sweet-tooth cravings with these elegant-looking treats housed in their signature pink boxes. Choose from over 40 flavours of gourmet cupcakes at Twelve Cupcakes. Baked daily, with the finest ingredients and handmade with love. They are the perfect thing to bring to any gathering, or just to give your day a sweet ending!

description: Twenty Loaf Toasties serves made-to-order grilled toasts loaded with fresh ingredients! Try our signature Cheesy Bakkwa Toasties: generous portions of sweet and savoury Chicken Bakkwa and Floss.

name: Wanglu Hot Pot
description: Wanglu Hot Pot is a steamboat restaurant that allows every customers to have their own pot for cooking. Its vision is to offer high quality food and service to customers of all ages. With a focus on hygiene and a comfortable dining environment, along with a wide variety of soup bases, Wang Lu will definitely satisfy your hot pot cravings.

name: Warabimochi Kamakura
description: Explore Warabimochi Kamakura for a genuine slice of Japan with their exquisite Warabimochi and creative Warabimochi Drinks. Each offering is a contemporary take on classic tastes, designed for the sophisticated palate. Warabimochi Kamakura provides a distinctive gastronomic adventure where tradition blends with modernity. Experience the fusion of time-honoured flavours and innovative craftsmanship with every visit.

name: Wen Zhang Lao Mian
description: Wen Zhang Lao Mian, a specialist in noodle making and soup development, was established in China in 2017. Over the years, our brand has become well-known. Our goal is to provide a unique dining experience and a comforting atmosphere for all our customers. Among our most beloved noodle dishes are Spicy Beef Noodle, Tomato Soup with Fried Pork, Herbal Soup with Braised Pork, Soup Spicy Fish, and Golden Fish Soup. In addition to noodles, we offer a variety of fried rice, Chinese dishes, and enticing desserts.

name: White Restaurant
description: Welcome to White Restaurant, home to The Original Sembawang White Beehoon – an iconic truly-Singaporean delicacy, alongside renowned dishes like Hainanese Chicken Rice and Chilli Crab. Our founder, Mr Tay, originally crafted this comforting dish, which has since captured the hearts of many. The Original Sembawang White Beehoon stands out with its exceptional flavours and distinctiveness. It has earned its own identity and holds a special place in the hearts of food enthusiasts. While many have tried to imitate our signature dish, none can match its unparalleled taste. That’s why we have rebranded ourselves as White Restaurant, symbolizing the heritage and uniqueness of The Original White Beehoon.

name: Wingstop
description: Serving the World Flavour through an unparalleled guest experience and offering of classic wings, boneless wings and tenders, always cooked to order and hand-sauced-and-tossed in fans’ choice of 10 bold, distinctive flavours, including fans’ favourite Kecap Manis that is exclusive to Singapore. Wingstop’s menu also features signature sides including seasoned fries, hand-breaded mushroom fritters and freshly-made ranch dip.

name: Wok Hey
description: Masters of stir fry ⋅ Lovers of wok hey. Wok Hey serve the best rice and noodles in town. Cos' they just love stir fry.

Dive into a world of savory delights at WOK The Fish! and savor the essence of the sea in every spoonful.

name: XW Plus Western Grill
description: Being the western casual dining place, XW Western Grill is your one-stop for all things grilled. Offering a line-up of smoky favourites such as steaks, chicken and fish, the combination of mouth-watering natural juices and charred flavours are perfect for insatiable palates. Our all-you-can-eat salad bar boasting unlimited servings of hot and cold sides won’t disappoint either, it comes free with any main course order or go straight for the à la carte salad bar. Kick back and enjoy western grub in this vibrant value-for-money diner – a perfect avenue for gatherings with family and friends.

name: YAYOI
description: YAYOI is a Japanese Teishoku Restaurant. They serve "Teishoku" which includes a good balance of steamed rice (Japanese staple food), miso soup, main dish, side dish and other items on a tray. YAYOI will pass down Japan's delicious food to the future and spread it to the world.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 8am to 9pm (Last Order at 8.30pm)

As the name may suggest, it specialises in teochew style fishball noodles with nostalgic flavour and taste. The introduction of Astons Steak & Salad was the result of fulfilling a better commitment to all customers. This restaurant features Astons in a Steak & Salad bar concept where there are over 80 selections of all-you-can-eat salads at the bar including home-made soup, fresh greens and dessert. Our menu boasts a variety of main courses including our signature steaks, which comes with buffet serving at the salad bar. Other items on the menu include seafood entree, grilled chicken and kids meal. The restaurant is simply designed to give a pleasant and private atmosphere with jazz music in the background. It will be a place for all occasions. At Astons, it is a quality and value for money concept.

At Aburi-EN, you can enjoy the best of Japanese drinking culture with an extensive selection of highballs, beers, shochu and sake that complements the array of grilled meats. Focusing on premium ingredients grilled to perfection and offered at affordable prices, it’s little wonder why Aburi-EN is a favourite amongst many.

name: Auntie Ashley
description: Rooted in the rich culinary heritage of Ipoh, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam brings the true taste of Malaysia’s most celebrated food town to the heart of Orchard, The Centrepoint. Inspired by the success of Choy Kee Bakery in Ipoh, this new outlet continues the same dedication to authenticity, tradition, and comfort food that generations have grown up loving. Every dish served is a tribute to Ipoh’s time-honoured kopitiam culture, where simple ingredients are elevated through craftsmanship, patience, and recipes passed down through generations. At the heart of the menu is our signature Nasi Ayam Goreng Berempah, marinated with over ten aromatic Malay spices and fried to golden perfection—crispy on the outside, juicy within, and deeply fragrant. Our Ipoh Hor Fun is another standout, made using rice noodles renowned for their silky smooth texture, a hallmark of Ipoh’s mineral-rich spring water. Served in comforting chicken broth or bold curry, each bowl delivers warmth, depth, and unmistakable authenticity. Complementing the mains are classic sides like Hainanese Chicken Chop Rice, Sizzling Hot Plate Claypot Noodles, and freshly prepared dim sum that recall the bustling kopitiams of old Ipoh. No Ipoh experience is complete without coffee. Our authentic Ipoh Chang Jiang White Coffee, roasted with butter for a smoother, richer aroma, stays true to the original Ipoh method, offering a nostalgic cup that pairs perfectly with Choy Kee Egg Tarts. From hearty rice dishes to nostalgic desserts and handcrafted drinks, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam is more than a meal — it is a comforting journey home, familiar yet exciting, for those who are seeking genuine Ipoh flavours in Singapore.

name: Awfully Chocolate

Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, their signature Ayam Penyet is served with sambal that packs one helluva punch so you'll definitely want to try their Avocado Juice to balance it out. Or perhaps indulge in one of their more interesting concoctions - Soda Gembira (Happy Soda) and Teh Botol Sosro (Indonesian Bottled Jasmine Tea).

It goes beyond a car brand by offering a curated sustainable lifestyle that transforms how people drive, dine, and live.

name: Bae.gal by Swee Heng
description: Bae.Gal is a brand-new concept by Swee Heng Bakery. Specializing in Asian-style bagels with a soft and chewy texture with our homegrown roots, Bae.Gal seeks to bring more excitement to the world of confectionery. At Bae.Gal, we think that treating our customers to a wide selection of savoury and sweet bites will satisfy their craves for bagels.

name: Baker’s Brew
description: Baker’s Brew is Singapore’s leading cake specialist serving the most beautiful and decadent cakes, one-of-a-kind pastries and cookies, perfect for both of life's little moments and big milestones.

name: Bali Thai
description: At Bali Thai, we bring you the best of both Thai and Indonesian cuisines. We want you to relish, experience, and enjoy this perfect fusion at affordable prices. Each Bali Thai restaurant boasts unique interior décor, blending contemporary style with traditional elements to offer a modern yet exotic dining experience. Perfect for family celebrations or casual business meals, Bali Thai consistently delights customers with delicious, affordable dishes. Our Halal certification also makes us a popular choice within the Muslim community. Some of the all-time favourites at Bali Thai include Tahu Telur - a must try typical Indonesian appetiser. This simple beancurd dish is fried with crispy egg fluffs coated on the outside and smooth eff residues on the inside. The specially prepared sweet peanut sauce that comes with it adds the extra oomph to the taste. For seafood lovers, opt for our popular Combi Bakar, which is a combo platter of mixed barbecue items, - fish, prawn, cuttlefish, chicken and satay. And what is Thai food without tasting the authentic, traditional Thai Green Curries? Diners will drool over a choice of our tender Chicken or Beef slices cooked in spicy hot curries, served together with fragrant steamed rice. For the best Thai soup, nothing beats the sour spicy Tom Yum Goong or Talay, which is best known among the Thais as their proud signature dish. It is flavourful and always unforgettable.

name: Bari Bari Steak
description: A concept from Hong Kong that celebrates the art of teppan cuisine. We specialise in premium Japanese steak cuts, alongside carefully selected cuts from other regions, all expertly seared on an iron griddle and served with a hot stone steak pellet made from high-density stone from Japan, heated up to 300°C, allowing you to continue searing your steak to your preferred doneness. Our steaks are served at a perfect medium rare, with specially curated Japanese donburi selections, sides and kids meals included. All teppan dishes come with complimentary free-flow Japanese salad bar, featuring a generous spread of fresh greens, sides, carbs and dessert.

name: Beard Papa’s
description: Since 1999, Beard Papa’s has been baking The World’s Best Cream Puffs. They began in Japan and have expanded to 430+ stores in the world; committed to serving pastries that are super oishii! (delicious!). Beard papa’s signature custard cream is made only from fresh and natural ingredients. You can smell the aroma of genuine vanilla bean, one of the most valuable spices on the planet and the richness of luxurious whipping cream and butter.

name: Beauty in The Pot
description: Savour the essence of health & beauty from our ten nourishing soup bases, which includes the all-time favourite Beauty Collagen Broth, Spicy Nourishing Broth and exclusive private room new soup selections. Every steaming pot of broth is prepared using an array of quality ingredients specially selected for a divine experience.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

name: Beutea
description: Beutea - a modern tea beverage brand using "Freshly Brewed Chinese Tea" (a combination of ancient Chinese and modern tea beverage). Beutea practices the four ancient tea ceremony skills “moisten”, “soak”, “boil”, and “brew” using extract from the finest hand-picked tea leaves originating from tea mountains of Yunnan and Wuyi in China as the base of their beverages. It is then blended with modern flavours such as fresh milk and fresh fruits to brew unique, exquisite, aromatic and delicious fresh tea beverages. “A sip of tea lingers, two sips come with a long aftertaste” serves as the purpose of founding the brand as they aspire to be the top unique and delicious fresh tea beverage brand.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 10.30am to 9.30pm Last order 9pm

description: A staple in the diet of many in Asia, we honour the art of bread-making by giving life to novel creations since our inception in 2000. BreadTalk is a distinctive, award-winning Singaporean brand that has gained international appeal for its signature Flosss. With the belief that every bun has a life of its own and a story to tell, BreadTalk is renowned for the way it has revolutionised the culture of bread consumption with creativity and innovation. At the heart of our brand, Flosss is an iconic product that has become synonymous with BreadTalk. Our range of breads goes far beyond Flosss, with new and exciting products regularly added to our lineup.

name: BreadTalk
description: BreadTalk has brought about a renaissance in the bread business, with multiple awards testifying to its branding and business successes. Each BreadTalk bears the urban, clear glass, clean cut look punctuated subtly with detailing of contrasting colours of artworks, unique to each locale. The signature 'see thru' kitchens allow Chefs to showcase their expertise upfront, sharing the preparation of the freshly browned breads, each piece has a story to tell... so beautifully crafted, so heavenly in taste... BreadTalk's attention to detail does not stop here. The brand strives to stay ahead constantly, making every effort to improve your BreadTalk experience because they want your trip to BreadTalk to be as deliciously rewarding as the buns you select.

Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.
opening_hours: BreadTalk: Monday to Friday 7.30am to 10.30pm Saturday, Sunday & PH 8am to 10.30pm Toast Box: Monday to Sunday 8am to 9.30pm

The brand holds a prestigious Highest International Authority ITI certification for quality, and utilises an exclusive patented Teapresso machine that allows custom settings and temperature control brewing technique to bring out the tea’s best flavour and natural scent, and maintain consistency in the quality and taste profiles of their tea. With high-quality tea as its mainstay, CHICHA San Chen marries the best of bubble tea with traditional tea bringing one of life’s greatest pleasures to the world.

name: Chinatown Tan's TuTu Coconut Cake
description: The original Kueh Tutu was called “san” or light cake which came in the form of a large cake of rice flour without any filling and was steamed in trays. The kuehs consist of ground roasted peanuts or grated coconut with brown palm sugar fillings and this is unique to Singapore. The late Mr Tan Tuan Chiang learned about Kueh Tutu when he joined his father’s trade more than 50 years ago. The Tans’ push-carts were familiar sights in Chinatown then. To ensure that he prepares the perfect old-style Tutu Kuehs, he pounds whole rice grains to make rice flour. The purity of whole rice grains ensures that his cake is pure white. The flour is sifted many times so that the cakes are truly “san” or light. Finally the cake is filled and steamed before being served on a piece of fragrant pandan leaf. Handcrafted from start to end, this is truly a nostalgic snack that diners can’t skip.

From our signature Gyudon (beef bowl) to crispy karaage and plant-based options, there’s something for everyone at Gyushi. Each bowl is a balance of tradition, comfort, and creativity. description: Welcome to HOT DUCK, your go-to spot for a delicious twist on the classic corndog! They specialize in authentic Korean-style corndogs, freshly made just for you. Next, add your favorite toppings—select from sweet corn, crispy potato, or crunchy flakes for that perfect texture. Don’t forget to finish it off with a selection of mouthwatering sauces. Every corndog is crafted to order, ensuring a delightful experience with every bite. Come and explore the delicious world of Korean corndogs at HOT DUCK today!

name: Hakka Yu
description: Founded in 2013, Hakka Yu (客语) is a celebrated name in Hakka cuisine with over 80 locations across China and a legacy spanning more than 20 years. Dedicated to preserving authentic Hakka flavours, Hakka Yu merges traditional, natural cooking techniques with fresh, regionally sourced ingredients, delivering the rich, mountain-inspired flavours of Hakka culture to urban diners. Through continuous innovation, Hakka Yu reinterprets classic Hakka dishes with a contemporary flair, broadening its appeal while ensuring its legacy of quality endures in both domestic and international markets. Hakka Yu’s commitment to culinary excellence has earned it multiple accolades, including recognition among China’s Top 100 Restaurant Brands (2019-2020), designation as a Guangzhou Culinary Landmark (2021-2024), and a spot on Dianping’s prestigious "Must-Eat List" (2022 and 2024).

name: Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart
description: Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart has been all the rage in South East Asia since June 2016. Originating from Hokkaido, our resident bakers worked with counterparts from Hokkaido, Japan to further improve the recipe of this baked pastry to ensure a uniqueness in taste and texture. The soft and creamy centre is made with a blend of three different types of specialty cheeses, piped into a crunchy shortcrust pastry base. Tasting best when it is right out of the oven, the Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart also taste awesome when chilled, giving you a smooth and refreshing experience. When frozen, the tart is alike a creamy cheesy ice cream. Try all the ways of eating it and decide which one you like best! Apart from the delicious original flavour, we now have the decadent chocolate and the King of Fruits, Durian.

Their secret recipe has been passed down through generations, ensuring that every bite is filled with authentic flavors that will transport you to the streets of Singapore. From the flaky pastry to the perfectly spiced fillings, each curry puff is made with love and care, using only the freshest ingredients. Whether you’re looking for a quick snack or a satisfying meal, their curry puffs are sure to satisfy your cravings. So come on down to Best Curry Puff in Singapore and taste the difference!

Achieving the honour of being awarded the prestigious One Michelin Star for two years in a row in the Tokyo Michelin Guide 2019 and 2020, it has been a journey for a ramen shop which started out as a humble 8-seater. Never resting on his laurels, Chef Yamamoto has once again created an exceptional concept for his 8th shop at Waterway Point. Debuting his “Bubble Soup”, the signature Porcini Cappuccino Ramen and Yuzu Cappuccino Ramen features a light and foamy Porcini and Yuzu sauce resembling the foam cap of a cappuccino.

KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

Since opening our first store in June 2022, Kyoto Onimaru has rapidly expanded across Asia and now operates 27 locations worldwide. Our Omusubis are well loved by both children and the elderly. We are dedicated to spreading happiness — one rice ball at a time — and winning the hearts of everyone we serve.

name: Lao Huo Tang
description: Share a tureen or two of traditional Cantonese-style soups from any of our 10 Lao Huo Tang Restaurants with your loved ones. Made fresh daily from scratch, these salubrious broths are made with vegetables, lean meat, pork ribs and other natural ingredients and simmered for hours. They are low in fat, calories and also low in sodium — no MSG, oil, cream or butter is used and its refillable for all dine-in customers. In addition to the nourishing soups, tuck into other traditional home-style dishes in the comfortable restaurant, which is both baby and wheelchair-friendly.

name: Lead General Hot Pot
description: In 1980, in Chongqing's Ciqikou, the Shuai family's old stove began crafting a legacy. Master Shuai pioneered the "Three Simmerings and Nine Brewings" beef tallow recipe, paired with the ancestral Nine-Square Grid technique, creating a hotpot known for its rich, layered flavors. The second-generation heir brought this tradition to New York, where the aroma of Chongqing hotpot became a nostalgic symbol for many. Now, he heads to the Lion City, launching "Lead General" hotpot in May 2025, blending century-old techniques with Southeast Asian influences. From Ciqikou to Manhattan, and now to Singapore, "Lead General" aims to share the essence of Chinese hotpot with the world. With a copper pot and a blend of spices, we embark on a journey to let the world savor the timeless flavors of China.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 10pm (Last order at 9.30pm)

name: LiHO TEA

A simple greeting of LiHO is a great way for individuals to bond and it is even better with a cup of Singapore’s homegrown tea brand, LiHO Tea. Brown Sugar Pearl, Avocado and Fruit Tea are what LiHO does best and it is the heart of our brand.” Great emphasis is placed on the entire process, from choosing the right tea to roasting, to brewing and finally serving it.

name: Mincheng Bibimbap
description: Mincheng Bibimbap 민정비빔밥 敏丁拌饭 is a renowned establishment specializing in Chinese Korean （中国朝鲜族）ethnic cuisine, offering a unique blend of flavors that reflect the rich culinary heritage of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture in China. Our menu boasts diverse dishes, with the iconic Mincheng Bibimbap taking center stage. In addition to this signature dish, we offer Stone Plate series and a selection of savory soups inspired by Korean traditions. Complementing these are complimentary offerings like Rice Kimchi and seaweed soup, ensuring a complete and satisfying dining experience.

name: Ministry of Rojak
description: Ministry of Rojak, an expansion of Abdhus Salam Rojak (hailing from Ayer Rajah hawker centre) is dedicated to providing authentic traditional Indian hawker food with an innovative twist without compromising neither its quality nor taste. Its famous sweet potato sauce has a smooth nutty touch that lends a nice texture to the overall sensation and not forgetting a delicious array of Pratas and all the famous mamak gorengs accompanied with its famous hot and cold beverages.

name: Misato
description: A stylish and modern showcase of Japanese gastronomy, Misato offers an elevated dining experience where tradition meets innovation. Enjoy meticulously prepared dishes that capture the essence of Japanese fine dining, served at prices that make exceptional cuisine accessible.

name: Mixue
description: MIXUE is a national chain brand dedicated to creating fresh ice cream and tea for young people. Since establishment in 1997, it has always been adhering to the principle of high quality and affordable price, and committed to promoting better and faster development of the global ice cream and tea industry!

name: Mixue
description: Mixue is a bubble tea brand that offers freshly made drinks, specializing in high- quality, affordable products such as bubble tea, fruit tea, and ice cream, providing customers with a convenient and delicious beverage experience

name: Monster Curry
description: Monster Curry is Singapore’s leading Japanese curry chain restaurant. Be mesmerized by the distinct flavour of the curry sauce, made from fresh fruits and a special blend of spices, resulting in a truly unique Japanese curry. With a spiciness level of your choosing, coupled with a range of assortments on a whopping plate size of 41cm in diameter, no one will leave feeling unfulfilled. The even bigger Japanese combo curry rice options are perfect for sharing. Other items such as Japanese pastas, curry ramen and honey toast are available to round out your meal.

name: Monster Planet
description: Monster Planet is iconic for its gigantic 35cm and 41cm plates, filled with delicious curry made using 14 different types of vegetables and spices, served atop rice or noodles. There are five levels of spiciness, ranging from Normal Spicy to Monster Spicy.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.
opening_hours: Monday to Friday 6.30am to 10pm Saturday, Sunday & PH 7am to 10pm

description: Since 2007, Mr YouTiao has been promoting youtiao, an otherwise plain and traditional snack. Why youtiao you may ask? Because YouTiao is tasty, crispy, fluffy and chewy all at once! We believe the combination is unique and unmatched among other dough-related food products. They now serve a whole range of food & beverage items that compliment youtiao. Traditional coffee and tea, soya milk, beancurd, porridge, curry chicken, bah kut teh, tastie noodles, butterfly buns… You name it!

description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

description: Authentic Japanese flavours meet local inspiration at Mr. Onigiri. Serving up homely onigiri sandwiches with creative twists, like the crowd-favourite Otakotak Onigiri, every bite is hearty, comforting, and full of character. Prices remain refreshingly reasonable — making it easy to enjoy a quick Japanese bite without compromise.

name: Munchi Pancakes
description: We serve both the classic Min Jiang Kueh and Munchi pancakes with creative hot and cold fillings for a modern twist on tradition. We take pride in using high-quality ingredients to ensure the freshest taste. We also offer vegan-friendly options, so that everyone can enjoy our delicious creations. Experience the perfect balance of tradition and innovation in every bite.

name: Munchi Pancakes
description: At Munchi Pancakes, they offer the classic Min Jiang Kueh—crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and filled to perfection. Their menu features pancakes which are made with hot and cold fillings for a fresh twist on tradition. For those who prefer smaller bites, the Mini Munchi offers bite-sized treats packed with irresistible flavors. They take pride in using fresh ingredients to ensure the freshest taste. Plus, they offer vegan-friendly options so everyone can enjoy the delicious creations. Experience the perfect balance of tradition and innovation with every bite.

name: Munchi Pancakes

Experience the perfect balance of tradition and innovation with every bite

name: My Korean Mom’s Kimchi
description: Annyeong! Korean mom & son duo that brings authentic korean food experience to your home. Enjoy their affordable, authentic takeaway dishes - complete with lovingly handmade banchan. From their signature freshly made kimchi and refreshing cucumber kimchi to hot favourites like hand‑rolled gimbap and spicy chicken katsu bibimbap, there’s something delicious for everyone.

name: Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specialises in traditional handmade pau from authentic traditional recipes of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in-house. You can also indulge yourself in a hearty serving of mee hoon kuay or ke kou mian as well as lor mai kai (glutinous rice chicken) and siew mai, just to name a few.

name: Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specialises in traditional handmade pau from authentic traditional recipes of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. You can also indulge yourself in a hearty serving of mee hoon kuay or ke kou mian as well as lor mai kai (glutinous rice chicken) and siew mai, just to name a few.

name: Nan Yang Dao
description: Nan Yang Dao (南洋岛) is a fast-growing Malaysian-inspired kopitiam chain launched in Singapore in 2022 by Malaysian chef Jackson Chu alongside brothers Wee and Vincent Liow. The brand aims to deliver “the best flavours of Malaysia” through classic regional dishes such as Penang fried kway teow, Penang assam laksa, KL Hokkien mee, and its unique Nanyang Fried Nasi Lemak.

name: Nelly's Retro Snacks
description: Founded on 9 April 2017, Nelly's Retro Snacks aims to keep their products at an affordable price and offering the largest and widest variety. They hope that the history of traditional school retro snacks will be enjoyed and appreciated by many generations.

name: NiKU iKU
description: NiKU iKU brings you authentic grilled & simmered Japanese takeout, crafted for comfort and satisfaction. From flame-kissed yakiniku to slow-simmered nitsuke, every bowl features rich flavour & the finest cuts — paired with premium Niigata rice and proprietary sauces. Every meal is a satisfying experience.

name: Nine Fresh
description: Nine Fresh is a home-grown brand specializing in a wide selection of chilled taro ball desserts that are freshly scooped and served daily. With 3 different types of signature bases (Bean Curd, Grass Jelly and Ai-Yu Jelly) and a huge variety of toppings such as beans, jellies as well as chewy delights (signature taro balls, mini taro Q and black pearl), they cater to different palates and preferences!

description: Old Chang Kee is a household name famous for it's delectable curry puffs that are filled with curried potatoes, chicken and a slice of hardboiled egg, all cooked with special herbs and spices. description: Old Chang Kee is a beloved Singaporean brand celebrated for its iconic Curry’O and a delicious variety of local snacks. Beyond its signature puffs, Old Chang Kee offers crowd favourites like Chicken Wing, Sotong Wing OnStik, Fish Ball OnStik, Spring’O, and more — ensuring there’s something for everyone to enjoy. Whether you're in the mood for a light bite or a satisfying snack, Old Chang Kee is your go-to stop for local delights.

name: Old Tea Hut
description: At Old Tea Hut, we brew fresh all day long, just for you. Our love for fine tea blends, rich coffee roast and tantalising beverages start our dedication to bringing you an exciting gastronome menu experience. We offer different flavours of tea and coffee beverages from time-honoured traditional drinks to original Old Tea Hut creations, as well as flavourful alternative beverages. So whatever your preference is, we’ll have the right beverage to tantalize your taste buds! We welcome you to discover and enjoy a taste of Old Tea Hut today.

name: Otter Pizza
description: Concept conceived in 2019, Otter Pizza aims to provide a wider variety of quality pizza choices with an affordable price tag to fellow Singaporean in heartland areas. Relying on their expertise in supply chain management and high efficiency achieved from centralized operation, Otter Pizze believe quality can be affordable. Otter Pizza position themselves as a “Neighbourhood Pizzeria” that welcomes repeated visits with family members, friends, couples, and more, throughout their daily lives.

name: Ottie Pancakes
description: Ottie Pancakes brings you the beloved traditional Min Jiang Kueh (MJK ) , also known as Apam Balik, with a delightful modern twist. At Ottie Pancakes, we serve soft, fluffy pancakes in a variety of unique flavors that cater to both traditional and adventurous taste buds. Every bite is crafted to deliver "Sweet Moments in Every Bite", combining nostalgia with a fresh, irresistible twist. Whether you love the classic fillings or are looking to explore new flavours, Ottie Pancakes promises a satisfying treat for everyone!

name: PUTIEN
description: PUTIEN serves cuisine from the Fujian Province in China: characteristically light, down-to-earth, and flavourful food with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. Signatures like Fujian Red Mushroom Seafood Lor Mee, ‘100-Second’ Stewed Yellow Croaker and PUTIEN Bian Rou Soup showcase the culinary richness of Fujianese cuisine that will fill your stomach and heart.

name: PUTIEN MAMA
description: PUTIEN MAMA welcomes you with a selection of PUTIEN favourites at everyday locations and prices. Just as mamas are the heartbeat of every family, we care for you with comfort food made from fresh, best-quality ingredients. From savoury, flavourful lor mee to our signature bee hoon made with fine, translucent vermicelli, authentic Heng Hwa recipes are served fresh, hot, and fast with a mama’s touch.

name: Paik's Noodle
description: Bringing you hot favourites such as Jajangmyeon, Jjamppong & Tangsuyuk by South Korean Celebrity Chef Paik Jong Won! Known in its homeland as “Hong Kong Banjeom 0410,” Paik’s Noodle is a culinary hotspot launched in 2006, in Seoul to provide the best flavours, recipes, and sauces by sustaining the real essence of a Korean Chinese restaurant. Paik's Noodle serves a variety of authentic Korean-Chinese dishes like Jjamppong (a hot, flavourful seafood noodle soup), and Paik’s Signature Tangsuyuk (crispy sweet and sour pork) with both being perfect options for sharing with friends or family. Spicy food lovers will love the spice in Jjamppong while kids would love the sweetness and crispness from Tangsuyuk.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 9pm (8:30pm last order)

name: Papa Ayam
description: Established in 2018 with a food kiosk concept, Papa Ayam deliver the fusion of crispy fried chicken with Indonesian authentic sambal. Ayam (Chicken) and Geprek (Smashed or Crashed) served with traditionally-made original sambal on mortar and pestle that you can choose your spicy level from Level 1 – level 15! Papa Ayam assure you the freshness of the sambal as it is made on the spot according to your spice level. Apart from that, they also serve Sambal Matah (Balinese sambal) and Cabe Ijo (green chilli).

name: Paris Baguette
description: Paris Baguette, born in 1988, is a global bakery brand of SPC Group, a leading South Korean food and confectionery corporation. From its modest beginnings, the chain has grown steadily to become the No.1 bakery in Korea. From 2004, the brand has expanded internationally, the brand operates around 4,000 stores worldwide across the United States, Canada, France, UK, China and Southeast Asia, solidifying its reputation as a truly global premium bakery brand. Paris Baguette is committed to blending traditional baking techniques with modern innovation to deliver diverse range of products such as breads, pastries, cakes, and beverages that appeal to a wide audience, from everyday treats to special celebration.

name: Paris Baguette
description: Born from a love of bread and a passion for quality, Paris Baguette is an international, fast-casual bakery founded in 1988 specialized in French-inspired baked goods offering chef-inspired cakes, pastries, freshly made sandwiches and salads with signature coffee and tea. Paris Baguette aims to offer a unique experience to thousands of guests daily.

The refreshed concept features a revamped store design and packaging, an all-new menu of flavours inspired by iconic global cuisines, and a lineup of mouthwatering sides to match. From its vibrant updated interior to pizzas that transport tastebuds across continents. Pezzo is back, this time with a new flavourful evolution elevating its signature fun-loving spirit that we’ve all come to know and love.

We aim to deliver not just a wide array of pizzas, pastas and other quality foods that are always fresh, but also a casual atmosphere that is fun and friendly. All these without compromising what good restaurants have always stood for, service and customer satisfaction.

Perfect for everyday treats or easy gifting, Plum Village turns simple snacking into something a little more special — naturally good, beautifully done.

All to give you an incredibly rich soul-satisfying taste of history!

description: Global french fries chain Potato Corner has been delighting fries lovers all over the world since 1992, serving up what many have called the “world’s best flavoured fries”. Fries are prepared fresh, fried to order, seasoned with passionately formulated flavours, and served hot and crispy. Take your pick from Cheese, Barbecue, Sour Cream & Onion, Chili Barbecue and a whole lot more!

description: Poulet is a modern French-themed bistro offering affordable French classics to the mass public since 2012. The Poulet Roti is complemented with 4 signature sauces, they create a perfect symphony for the signature dish. Poulet presents itself as the perfect place for any occasion worth celebrating, with something for everyone to savour and indulge in.

description: PrimaDéli serves all-time favourites that everyone loves and enjoys. description: Established in 1992, PrimaDéli is Singapore's first home-grown halal bakery franchise and a leading brand for high-quality cakes, pastries, breads, and other baked goods. Known for its iconic Pandan Chiffon Cake, freshly baked waffles, and a wide range of local and Western bakes, it has been a beloved part of Singaporean culture for decades.

description: Embracing quality and consistency as their cornerstones, Qi Ji has captivated people’s taste buds for decades with their irresistible and original recipes. name: Ramen Hitoyoshi
description: Ramen Hitoyoshi specializes in serving one of the world’s most popular dishes, Tonkotsu Ramen. Tonkotsu Ramen comes with a rich and thick broth, coupled with home-made Chashu, noodles, Ajitama (flavoured egg), and other fresh ingredients, making it flavourful and extremely palatable.

name: Red Ginger
description: Red Ginger is the creation of a dedicated team of food lovers, having decades of experience in the F&B industry. It first started operating at IMM Building since 2000, gaining a strong presence in the West region of Singapore through serving a remarkable spread of Nasi Padang dishes. Red Ginger's niche expertise lies in halal cuisine with a modern twist, dedicated to bringing top-notch fare to customers at affordable prices. A strong focus on its traditional cooking methods of Nasi Padang complemented with authentic local wok dishes ensures a gastronomical experience that must not be missed!

name: Red Ginger Coffeehouse
description: Red Ginger Coffeehouse is the evolved expression of our beloved culinary journey, crafted by a passionate team of food enthusiasts with over two decades of experience in the F&B industry. Building on the legacy of Red Ginger & Rumah Sayang, we now bring a fresh and modern take to our cherished Malaysian and local Singaporean favorites. We have been dedicated to delivering authentic halal cuisine with an elevated touch—offering a nuanced blend of tradition and contemporary culinary refinement. Our focus remains on signature dishes like Nasi Padang and local wok specialties, prepared using traditional techniques with a modern presentation and improved service that elevates your dining experience. Red Ginger Coffeehouse is where familiar flavors meet modern sophistication—offering slightly higher quality ingredients and a welcoming ambiance that invites you to indulge without the high-end price tag. Join us to rediscover classic tastes, reimagined for today’s discerning palate.

name: Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine
description: Experience the rich, slow-cooked flavours of Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine, where hearty claypot dishes take centre stage. Savour signature Claypot Grilled Qing Jiang Fish in Green Pepper Sauce, Beef Brisket with Potato and Radish, or Tomato Salt Baked Chicken, each meticulously prepared to perfection. The menu also features many other flavourful claypots and a selection of other Cantonese dishes, perfect for enjoying hot, comforting meals.

name: Robochef
description: Robochef will offer a choice of 17 dishes of familiar Singapore favourites, cooked to perfection in mere minutes. Tapping on local culinary experts to fine tune the recipes to local Singapore tastes, Robochef will offer customers delicious food at affordable prices. The unique use of AI allows a perfect blending of ingredients, seasoning and the optimization of cooking times.

name: S.O.S Chicken by Wine Connection
description: S.O.S Chicken is on a mission to unite various flavours and fragrances on a staple dish - a tender, juicy charcoal-grilled chicken, served with an array of Stand Out Sauce (S.O.S) to reflect Singapore's diverse culinary scene! A simple pairing, yet can be enjoyed in various ways depending on your craving or mood. Get sossy with an array of sauces and sides that are inspired by cuisines from all around the world.

name: SEOUL NOODLE SHOP
description: SEOUL NOODLE SHOP is an Authentic Korean handcrafted knife-cut noodles restaurant prepared with traditional techniques. Following the proverb "All good things come to Seoul," SEOUL NOODLE SHOP aims to offer the best noodles in Korea. From the noodle dough to the broth and kimchi, every food is meticulously prepared and served. Skilled artisans create firm, chewy noodles, while the broth, brewed with great care, adds depth and flavor to the knife-cut noodles. Handmade dumplings and kimchi are also available to accompany the meal. At SEOUL NOODLE SHOP, you can savor the authentic taste of Korean food made with dedication and using time-honored techniques.

name: SF Fruits & Juices
description: SF started off with its first outlet in Orchard Road in 2004 selling cut fruits and juices. They now have around 30 outlets island wide with some selling whole fruits as well. SF strives to provide quality fruits and farm produce to all at affordable prices.

description: SF started off with its first outlet in Orchard Road in 2004 selling cut fruits and juices. They now have around 30 outlets island wide with some selling whole fruits as well. SF strives to provide quality fruits and farm produce to all at affordable prices.

name: SUKIYA
description: SUKIYA is Japan’s No. 1 quick-service restaurant, founded in 1982 in Yokohama, and has over 2,600 locations across the world. SUKIYA specializes in Gyudon – a delicious combination of thinly-sliced tender beef cooked in a soy sauce-based savory sauce with onions all served on top of fluffy, perfectly-cooked Japanese rice. Renowned for its lightning-fast, friendly and energetic service, SUKIYA uplifts and energizes its customers around the world by providing a truly authentic Japanese experience to all.

name: Sakon Thai
description: Sakon Thai serves authentic Thai food with light customization to suit the local taste. The food concept combines flavors from the original Sakon Town located in Northeast Thailand and the Gau Yuak Temple in Chiang Mai. The founder has been a regular donor to the temple and has stayed there for some time. He was so impressed by the dishes cooked by the locals for the temple visitors and has since brought these special flavors to Singapore, in 2008 opening the first Sakon Thai in Serangoon North. Today if you visit Sakon Thai you can taste these special recipes in the dishes like the Fried Fish Red & Green Sauce and the Sambal fried kanggong.

name: Seoul Garden
description: With Seoul Garden's signature Korean Barbeque grill and steamboat dining concept and a wide range of food to choose from, Seoul Garden caters to all type of guests. Allow them to create your next memorable experience. Celebration better with family and friends, here at Seoul Garden Buffet.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11.30am to 10.30pm (Last order at 9.45pm)

name: Shi Li Fang Hot Pot
description: A Taiwan steamboat restaurant chain since 2013. Shi Li Fang have various types of hot pot provide to customer. We also have some special value set meals, premium set meal for customers to choose. Whether you are working or gatherings, both can be easily get the type of hot pot you like in SHI LI FANG

name: Shi Li Fang Hot Pot & One Pot
description: At 热辣滚烫 One Pot, we bring you Ma La Tang and Ma La Ban with a local twist! Our delicious broth is packed with rich flavors, and our wide selection of fresh ingredients lets you create the perfect bowl, just the way you like it. Whether you prefer soup or dry mix, mild or bold flavors, there’s something for everyone. Pair it with crispy fried toppings and silky scrambled eggs for an unforgettable meal. Shi Li Fang Hot Pot has become the most economical hot pot restaurant chain that provides the widest range of dishes and sauces in Singapore. They have successfully created a healthy Singapore centric hot pot through careful food selection according to Singapore's multi- ethnicity, suitable for all demographics. Committed to share their hot pot creations to all, they will continue to expand and reach everyone here in Singapore.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food
description: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food® is everybody's favorite Taiwanese food chain featuring popular snacks from the alleys of Taiwan's night markets. Prepared the way they do over in Taiwan, the menu features authentic favorites such as XXL Crispy Chicken, Crispy Floss Egg Crepe, Handmade Oyster Mee Sua and Seafood Tempura.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food
description: Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks® is everybody's favorite Taiwanese food chain featuring popular snacks from the alleys of Taiwan's night markets. Prepared the way they do over in Taiwan, the menu features authentic favorites such as XXL Crispy Chicken, Crispy Floss Egg Crepe, Handmade Oyster Mee Sua and Seafood Tempura.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks
description: Thousands of Taiwanese crowd the local nightmarkets in search of their favorite and delicious snacks, and Taipei’s Shihlin Night Market is the most famous due to its very wide range of local delicacies in its small streets and alleys. If a snack is nice, you can surely find it in Shihlin! The locals say, “If Taiwan has it, Shihlin has it.” With Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks®, the Taiwanese and us alike can now do the same and enjoy the wonderful street snacks of Taiwan!

name: Shine Korea
description: Singapore's leading retailer of Korean product, Shine Korea provide the reliable delivery of authentic Korean products at the best price. The wide range of product available from noodles to snacks to sauces and cooking ware makes Shine Korea the go-to-place for everything Korean.

name: Shine Korea
description: Singapore's leading retailer of Korean product, Shine Korea provide the reliable delivery of authentic Korean products at the best price. The wide range of product available from noodles to snacks to sauces and cooking ware makes Shine Korea the go-to-place for everything Korean.

name: Shiok Burger
description: Shiok Burger delivers bold, Singaporean-style burgers that fuse local flavors with juicy, handcrafted patties — a truly shiok taste you won’t forget. Perfect for indulgent meals, hearty bites and flavour-packed comfort food lovers.

name: Snackz It!
description: Snackz It! Is a brands created in Singapore and establishes in 2005 selling creative street cuisine. Our business has grown over the years and we now boast a presence beyond Singapore. We are committed to bringing our customers the tastiest street food, using the freshest ingredients and most dedicated service. We want you to enjoy our food and we are obsessed with getting them right for you.

name: So Do Fun
description: Specializing in "Boiled Live Fish" as its signature dish, SO DO FUN is a popular Sichuan restaurant chain renowned for its "fresh ingredients prepared on-site." With just this one handcrafted boiled live fish dish, it has remained popular for 18 years, operating nearly 100 direct stores across China, Singapore, and Malaysia. For years, it has consistently ranked among the top three on regional Sichuan cuisine lists and dominated as the No. 1 popular Sichuan brand in various markets. It was listed on the "Dianping Must-Eat List" in 2018 and 2023. For 18 years, SODOFUN has used fresh ingredients.

name: So Do Fun
description: So Do Fun Sichuan Cuisine was founded in 2007 and is renowned for its signature dish — Boiled Live Fish. We use fresh, live ingredients prepared daily on-site, bringing the authentic taste of Sichuan to every table. For 18 years, So Do Fun has remained one of the most beloved Sichuan restaurants, consistently ranking as a top choice on local food charts. Today, we operate nearly 100 outlets across China, Singapore, and Malaysia, serving over one million bowls of boiled fish annually.

name: So Pho
description: So Pho's cuisine captures the true flavor of traditional Vietnamese cuisine like no other restaurant in Singapore. In So Pho, we offer wide range of food offerings from across Vietnam. Take your pick from spring rolls, to noodles and banh mi as well as other main dishes and desserts.

name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh
description: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh have come a long way from one food cart on the street. Yet their pushcart icon reminds us what they are about, an original Bak Kut Teh experience: tender, fall-off-the-bone pork ribs; hot, flavourful, spicy-peppery soup; a 1960s roadside dining ambience. At Song Fa, the heritage of Bak Kut Teh lives on in its truest sense.eritage of good old Bak Kut Teh in it's truest sense.
opening_hours: Monday to Thursday 11am to 9pm Friday 11am to 9.30pm Saturday 10.30am to 9.30pm Sunday 10.30am to 9pm Public Holiday Monday to Thursday 10.30am to 9pm Friday to Sunday 10.30am to 9.30pm

name: Song Gye Ok
description: The World's First Restaurant Dedicated to Chicken Specialty Cuts, Six Unique Specialty Cuts of Fresh, Whole Chicken Founded in Seongsu, Seoul, Song Gye Ok is Korea’s most talked-about chicken grill house, drawing queues for its juicy 6-part chicken cuts and soul-warming herbal Samgyetang. Now in Singapore, we continue this legacy with the same recipes, premium ingredients, and hospitality. Designed with traditional Hanok elements, our space blends modern city life with Korea’s timeless dining culture.

name: Soup Restaurant
description: Our origins may be traced back to 1991 when our first outlet was established in Smith Street. Our founders, Mok Yip Peng, Wong Wei Teck, Wong Chi Keong and Ho Hong Chin observed a surge in the popularity of Herbal Soups in Hong Kong, with the emergence of restaurants specialising in Herbal Soups. Inspired by this development, our founders were of the view that there would be a demand in Singapore for Herbal Soups and home-cooked dishes, especially by young professionals with limited access to home-cooked food.
opening_hours: Monday to Friday 11.30am to 2.30pm 5.30pm to 10pm Saturday, Sunday and Public Holiday 11.30am to 10pm

name: Spicy Chef
description: The “SPICY CHEF” brand is a new dining concept that focuses on Chinese-style stir-frying, with spicy stir-fried meat as its flagship dish. It is dedicated to promoting the culture of freshly-cooked Chinese cuisine and aims to provide consumers with safe, reliable, and cost-effective dining services.

description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

description: Steak 99 bring affordability with innovative lava stone cookware, offering a healthier and flavourful grilling experience. The porous structure of the stone naturally absorbs excess fat, delivering lower-calories healthier steak without compromising taste. Lava stone’s infrared ray effect and exceptional heat retention and ensures the meat stays hot, flavorful , and juicy from the first bite to the last, creating a unique and satisfying dining experience.

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff'd is a fast casual kiosk chain focused on Mexican and Turkish takeaways. Serving exceptionally tasty burritos and kebabs, the food is made and prepared fresh daily, right in front of you. The made to order flow allows you to choose whichever toppings you like, and their succulent grilled chicken is remarkably tasty as it is healthy. With its energetic customer base which swears by the food, many have invented their own secret menu of their favorite food combination. Go for the chicken kebabs if you’re new to Stuff’d, or if you’re looking for something even more filling, go for their Burritos!

Renowned for its lightning-fast, friendly and energetic service, SUKIYA uplifts and energizes its customers around the world by providing a truly authentic Japanese experience to all.

name: Swee Choon
description: Synonymous with timeless appeal and well-honed craftsmanship, Swee Choon has become a destination F&B venue for both locals and tourists. In “Destination Singapore”, a definitive guide for travel agents, the Singapore Tourism Board lists Swee Choon as one of the country’s must-visit food destinations.

name: Swee Heng 1989 Classic
description: Swee Heng 1989 Classic is a new brand born from the 1st Singapore full fledge halal bakery chain known as Swee Heng Bakery in the late 80s. Making its official debut at West Mall in 2014. Swee Heng 1989 Classic has since gained wide popularity and recognition from Singaporeans. Till date, we have opened a total of 27 outlets and 1 Bakery Cafes island wide. Holding on to the same promise made by Swee Heng Bakery, sharing our baking passion to all communities. Till now, we remain committed in using the finest ingredients gathered around the world to produce good quality and affordable products. Our vision is to become “Bakery of people, Bread for life”. We strive hard to make Swee Heng the Singapore Bakery that serves all communities.

description: Swensen’s is synonymous with sweet celebrations enjoyed together with loved ones for all occasions. A delectable tradition treasured by families. Swensen's is Singapore’s Family Restaurant of Choice, championing bonding over food, serving families & ice cream cakes since 1979.

description: Swensen’s is synonymous with sweet celebrations enjoyed together with loved ones for all occasions. A delectable tradition treasured by families. Swensen's is Singapore’s Family Restaurant of Choice, championing bonding over food, serving families & ice cream cakes since 1979.

name: TORA-SAN
description: Tora-San is a Japanese dish concept that serves creative rice bowls garnished with fresh sea products in an authentic and conducive street dining experience. Every bowl of Chirashi and Donburi is specifically designed with the right blend of sea products, taste and quantity to give the overall palate balance that suits all ages of diners to enjoy the meal.

name: TORI-Q
description: TORI-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated “Tare” (sauce) for enhanced flavours.

name: Tai Cheong Bakery
description: Tai Cheong Bakery was started in 1954 by egg tart Master Au Yeung’s uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. After taking over Tai Cheong Bakery, Au Yeung pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts, refining several other recipes using techniques he learned from his previous work in a hotel baking cakes. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street. The popularity of Tai Cheong remains till today.

name: Tai Chong Kok
description: At Tai Chong Kok, we have been making mooncakes and traditional Cantonese pastries the same way since 1935 - from scratch and by hand. For 3 generations we have used only premium ingredients to produce our authentic Cantonese confectionary. Tai Chong Kok mooncakes are renowned for their genuine taste of tradition. We are one of the very few bakeries left in Singapore that still produce our fresh lotus paste by hand using 100% pure lotus seeds with no preservatives added and these fill mooncakes that are formed in the same traditional wooden moulds used at the original Sago Street store in Chinatown more than 89 years ago. Today, you can still bring home our mooncakes in stringed brown paper bags, just as our forefathers did in pre-war Singapore. Tai Chong Kok is also famed for our traditional Nian Gao (Chinese New Year's cake) that are made using 100% pure glutinous rice. Tai Chong Kok products are handmade and baked daily with no preservative added in Singapore using time-honoured recipes and quality ingredients with full conformity to Stringent Quality Standards of SFA, HACCP and BizSafe.

name: Talad Thai Banana
description: Talad Thai Banana is an Authentic Thai recipe crafted with love. Their unique batter is made from the freshest ingredients prepared daily with love and good intentions. All products are vegetarian friendly and in fresh batches daily!

name: Teahouse by Soup Restaurant
description: During the 1950-70s, there were many renown teahouses in Chinatown. Back then, enjoying a hot soup with a couple of dim sum dishes was a daily habit for folks of Chinatown. At Teahouse by Soup Restaurant, we serve a variety of Nanyang flavors Dim Sum, such as "4 Beauties", "Ma Jie Chives Dumplings" and more. Enliven the Chinatown teahouse dining culture with us at Teahouse by Soup Restaurant.

name: Toast Box
description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is a Singaporean contemporary coffee chain rooted in the recreation of Nanyang coffee and toast culture popular during the 1960s and 70s. Step inside and be greeted by the fragrance of coffee made from freshly-ground caramelised coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites. The enticing aroma of brewed coffee and flavourful local delights infuse vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the nostalgic taste of a bygone era. In addition to preserving the taste of Nanyang at home, Toast Box is now also brewing in Hong Kong, Jakarta, Johor Bahru, Kuala Lumpur, and Chinese-Taipei, sharing the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: Toast Box
description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. Original Lanzhou Beef Noodles, using Halal meats, high quality fresh ingredients and a 15 spice blend premium stock.

name: Tonkatsu ENbiton
description: The very essence of our brand name, 'EN' representing a gathering place, and 'Biton' meaning beautiful, perfectly captures the soul of our restaurant. Tonkatsu ENbiton, a destination for authentic tonkatsu experiences. We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest pork from renowned farms in Japan and around the world, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavour in every dish. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every cut of pork we serve maintains the highest standards of quality and flavour. Our skilled chefs meticulously prepare each tonkatsu dish to perfection, using airy, light, and crispy panko (bread crumbs) imported from Saitama Prefecture of Japan for that delightful texture. Whether you're indulging in our tonkatsu or exploring our diverse menu of signature dishes like the A4/A5 Miyazaki gyukatsu, black curry ramen, sandos, or a simple take-out bento, expect a culinary journey celebrating the rich and complex flavours of Japanese cuisine

name: Tonkatsu by Ma Maison
description: Ma Maison, which is French for “my house”, is one of the most well-loved restaurant chain offering Western- Japanese fusion cuisine. One of the main draws is its irresistibly good pork cutlet—available as Rosu (pork loin) Katsu or the leaner Hire (pork fillet) Katsu—which undergoes an aging and marinating process before it is breaded and deep-fried. The pork cutlets are served in sets with rice, shredded cabbage, and tonjiru (miso soup with pork) and pickles—all refillable. To enjoy the best of both land and sea, order the premium Unagi Tonkatsu Kamado Set comprising premium charcoal-grilled unagi from Isshiki in Aichi prefecture, kamado- style rice cooked in a traditional Japanese earthen pot, pickles, nyumen (soup noodles) and a choice of Rosu or Hire Katsu.
opening_hours: Monday to Friday 11am to 2.30pm ; 5pm to 9.30pm Saturday to Sunday 11am to 9.30pm

name: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen
description: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen is a popular authentic Japanese hot stone ramen with an entertaining twist, with portions and a variety of menu good for sharing and for fun family dining.

name: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen
description: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen is a popular authentic Japanese hot stone ramen with an entertaining twist, with portions and a variety of menu good for sharing and for fun family dining. The dish is prepared in a 350°C hot stone bowl, where thick noodles and vegetables are placed before hot soup is poured over them, creating a dramatic steam effect that resembles a volcanic eruption. The " Okoge "  that forms when ingredients touch the hot stone, adds a fragrant aroma and delightful texture.
