name: AMACHA 阿嬷茶语
description: Singapore’s first herbal milk tea brand, Amacha blends Traditional Chinese herbs with modern milk tea culture to create comforting, wellness-inspired beverages for the new generation. Each cup is a tribute to grandma’s timeless recipes — brewed with care, balance, and a touch of nostalgia.

name: ANDES by ASTONS
description: Rooted in the rustic and traditional cowboy theme, ANDES by ASTONS brings the best quality and value-for-money steaks and other western fare to you. Being halal-certified and MUIS-accredited, ANDES is the answer to the calling of our Muslim friends for scrumptious and affordable steaks and western cuisine in Singapore. An alter-ego of ASTONS Specialities, where the menu is almost identical, ANDES uses the same high quality and fresh ingredients to serve up generous portions of food to our customers. The main menu consists of a wide selection of steak cuts, chicken and seafood with most main courses served with two side dishes of your choice, cold or hot. At ANDES, you can definitely find something that suits your palate. Great food at great prices with a great atmosphere, what more could you ask for?

name: ASTONS Steak & Salad
description: Astons brand established itself as a household name, synonymous with quality and affordability. The introduction of Astons Steak & Salad was the result of fulfilling a better commitment to all customers. This restaurant features Astons in a Steak & Salad bar concept where there are over 80 selections of all-you-can-eat salads at the bar including home-made soup, fresh greens and dessert. Our menu boasts a variety of main courses including our signature steaks, which comes with buffet serving at the salad bar. Other items on the menu include seafood entree, grilled chicken and kids meal. The restaurant is simply designed to give a pleasant and private atmosphere with jazz music in the background. It will be a place for all occasions. At Astons, it is a quality and value for money concept.
opening_hours: Monday to Thursday Lunch: 11.30am to 3pm Dinner: 5pm to 10pm Friday to Sunday & PH 11.30am to 10pm

name: Aburi-EN
description: Specialised in quality Japanese grilled meats. Aburi-EN offers a variety of high-quality donburi (rice bowls) at affordable prices in a comfortable and affable ambiance. Aburi-EN takes pride in its homemade umami-packed meat sauce, as well as the high-quality imported pork and the A4/A5 Miyazaki Wagyu it uses which has won Japan’s “National Wagyu Award” four consecutive times. At Aburi-EN, you can enjoy the best of Japanese drinking culture with an extensive selection of highballs, beers, shochu and sake that complements the array of grilled meats. Focusing on premium ingredients grilled to perfection and offered at affordable prices, it’s little wonder why Aburi-EN is a favourite amongst many.

name: Ajisen
description: Originating from Kumamoto Japan, Ajisen Ramen is famous for its white broth, made by simmering pork bones for many hours. Its Tonkotsu soup is rich in collagen, a protein which is good for the skin. Since 1968, Ajisen Ramen has strived to bring delicious and authentic ramen to people from all walks of life, serving young and old with our extensive ramen line-up.
opening_hours: Monday to Thursday 11.30am to 10pm Friday to Sunday & PH 11am to 10pm Last order 9.45pm

name: Ajisen Tanjiro
description: A brand extension of their flagship Ajisen Ramen, Ajisen Tanjiro features signature favourites from its parent brand and more! Beyond its ramen offerings, Ajisen Tanjiro's expanded menu includes Maze Soba, rice set meals and a delectable selection of side dishes to complete the meal.

name: Ajisen Tanjiro
description: A brand extension of their flagship Ajisen Ramen, Ajisen Tanjiro features signature favourites from its parent brand and more! Beyond its ramen offerings, Ajisen Tanjiro's expanded menu includes Maze Soba, rice set meals and a delectable selection of side dishes to complete the meal.

name: Ajumma's
description: Ajumma’s embodies the vibrant, intense flavours of Korean cuisine. We love the comfort that Korean food brings to people, served up in bowls of piping hot stews, wok-seared bulgogis and crispy, savoury pancakes. No matter your craving, sweet, sour, spicy or savoury, we’ve got a generous serving of it!

name: Alley.Wei
description: Alley Wei is a place where customers can find traditional, freshly made Taiwanese/Chinese street food favourites.

name: An Acai Affair
description: As Singapore’s largest Açaí brand, An Açaí Affair is proud to serve organic açaí in the purest and least diluted form, without any artificial sweeteners or liquids. Enjoy their açaí bowls as a refreshing and nutritious pick-me-up to combat Singapore's hot weather, at any time of the day.
opening_hours: Sunday to Thursday 11am to 9.30pm Friday & Saturday 11am to 10pm

description: As Singapore’s largest Açaí brand, An Açaí Affair is proud to serve organic açaí in the purest and least diluted form, without any artificial sweeteners or liquids. name: Au Croissant
description: Au Croissant, which stands for The Croissant, was founded and set up in 2019. The French have been known to produce the best and highest quality bread, inspiring us to make Au Croissant a French inspired bakery.

name: Auntie Anne's
description: Auntie Anne's, the renowned pretzel bakery, takes pride in offering handcrafted and oven-baked pretzels, made fresh daily in their stores. With a vast selection of over 20 sweet and savoury flavors, Auntie Anne's Singapore is halal certified and caters to a wide range of tastes and preferences, ensuring there's something for everyone. The dough is egg-free and dairy-free, making our pretzels both vegan and vegetarian-friendly when ordered without meat, chocolate, or butter. They're here to add an unexpected twist to your day and help you make the most of each moment, satisfying your craving for excitement.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 9pm (Last order at 8.30pm)

name: Auntie Anne's
description: Auntie Anne's, the renowned pretzel bakery, takes pride in offering handcrafted and oven-baked pretzels, made fresh daily in their stores. name: Auntie Ashley
description: Rooted in the rich culinary heritage of Ipoh, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam brings the true taste of Malaysia’s most celebrated food town to the heart of Orchard, The Centrepoint. Inspired by the success of Choy Kee Bakery in Ipoh, this new outlet continues the same dedication to authenticity, tradition, and comfort food that generations have grown up loving. Every dish served is a tribute to Ipoh’s time-honoured kopitiam culture, where simple ingredients are elevated through craftsmanship, patience, and recipes passed down through generations. At the heart of the menu is our signature Nasi Ayam Goreng Berempah, marinated with over ten aromatic Malay spices and fried to golden perfection—crispy on the outside, juicy within, and deeply fragrant. Our Ipoh Hor Fun is another standout, made using rice noodles renowned for their silky smooth texture, a hallmark of Ipoh’s mineral-rich spring water. Served in comforting chicken broth or bold curry, each bowl delivers warmth, depth, and unmistakable authenticity. Complementing the mains are classic sides like Hainanese Chicken Chop Rice, Sizzling Hot Plate Claypot Noodles, and freshly prepared dim sum that recall the bustling kopitiams of old Ipoh. No Ipoh experience is complete without coffee. Our authentic Ipoh Chang Jiang White Coffee, roasted with butter for a smoother, richer aroma, stays true to the original Ipoh method, offering a nostalgic cup that pairs perfectly with Choy Kee Egg Tarts. From hearty rice dishes to nostalgic desserts and handcrafted drinks, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam is more than a meal — it is a comforting journey home, familiar yet exciting, for those who are seeking genuine Ipoh flavours in Singapore.

name: Awfully Chocolate
description: Awfully Chocolate brings the humble cake back to its glory days! With an exquisite product line including the Super Stacked Cake, White Chocolate Creme Brulee Tart and Salted Butterscotch Brownie, you’ll be spoiled for choice.

name: Ayam Penyet President
description: Ayam Penyet President is a chain of Halal-certified casual dining restaurants serving authentic Indonesian cuisine. Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, their signature Ayam Penyet is served with sambal that packs one helluva punch so you'll definitely want to try their Avocado Juice to balance it out. Or perhaps indulge in one of their more interesting concoctions - Soda Gembira (Happy Soda) and Teh Botol Sosro (Indonesian Bottled Jasmine Tea).

description: BELLS Baking Studio, part of the larger BELLS Academic Group, is a baking experience centre that supports aspiring Bakers and Businesses in the areas of baking and pastry creation.

name: BYD by 1826
description: BYD by 1826 offers the world's first Automotive Lifestyle Experience. Founded in Singapore, BYD by 1826 introduces a visionary concept that fuses eco-friendly automotive innovation with creative culinary experiences. It goes beyond a car brand by offering a curated sustainable lifestyle that transforms how people drive, dine, and live.

name: Bae.gal by Swee Heng
description: Bae.Gal is a brand-new concept by Swee Heng Bakery. Specializing in Asian-style bagels with a soft and chewy texture with our homegrown roots, Bae.Gal seeks to bring more excitement to the world of confectionery. At Bae.Gal, we think that treating our customers to a wide selection of savoury and sweet bites will satisfy their craves for bagels.

name: Baker’s Brew
description: Baker’s Brew is Singapore’s leading cake specialist serving the most beautiful and decadent cakes, one-of-a-kind pastries and cookies, perfect for both of life's little moments and big milestones.

name: Bali Thai
description: At Bali Thai, we bring you the best of both Thai and Indonesian cuisines. We want you to relish, experience, and enjoy this perfect fusion at affordable prices. Each Bali Thai restaurant boasts unique interior décor, blending contemporary style with traditional elements to offer a modern yet exotic dining experience. Perfect for family celebrations or casual business meals, Bali Thai consistently delights customers with delicious, affordable dishes. Our Halal certification also makes us a popular choice within the Muslim community. Some of the all-time favourites at Bali Thai include Tahu Telur - a must try typical Indonesian appetiser. This simple beancurd dish is fried with crispy egg fluffs coated on the outside and smooth eff residues on the inside. The specially prepared sweet peanut sauce that comes with it adds the extra oomph to the taste. For seafood lovers, opt for our popular Combi Bakar, which is a combo platter of mixed barbecue items, - fish, prawn, cuttlefish, chicken and satay. And what is Thai food without tasting the authentic, traditional Thai Green Curries? Diners will drool over a choice of our tender Chicken or Beef slices cooked in spicy hot curries, served together with fragrant steamed rice. For the best Thai soup, nothing beats the sour spicy Tom Yum Goong or Talay, which is best known among the Thais as their proud signature dish. It is flavourful and always unforgettable.

name: Bari Bari Steak
description: A concept from Hong Kong that celebrates the art of teppan cuisine. We specialise in premium Japanese steak cuts, alongside carefully selected cuts from other regions, all expertly seared on an iron griddle and served with a hot stone steak pellet made from high-density stone from Japan, heated up to 300°C, allowing you to continue searing your steak to your preferred doneness. Our steaks are served at a perfect medium rare, with specially curated Japanese donburi selections, sides and kids meals included. All teppan dishes come with complimentary free-flow Japanese salad bar, featuring a generous spread of fresh greens, sides, carbs and dessert.

name: Beard Papa’s
description: Since 1999, Beard Papa’s has been baking The World’s Best Cream Puffs. They began in Japan and have expanded to 430+ stores in the world; committed to serving pastries that are super oishii! (delicious!). Beard papa’s signature custard cream is made only from fresh and natural ingredients. You can smell the aroma of genuine vanilla bean, one of the most valuable spices on the planet and the richness of luxurious whipping cream and butter.

name: Beauty in The Pot
description: Savour the essence of health & beauty from our ten nourishing soup bases, which includes the all-time favourite Beauty Collagen Broth, Spicy Nourishing Broth and exclusive private room new soup selections. Every steaming pot of broth is prepared using an array of quality ingredients specially selected for a divine experience.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

name: Beutea
description: Beutea - a modern tea beverage brand using "Freshly Brewed Chinese Tea" (a combination of ancient Chinese and modern tea beverage). Beutea practices the four ancient tea ceremony skills “moisten”, “soak”, “boil”, and “brew” using extract from the finest hand-picked tea leaves originating from tea mountains of Yunnan and Wuyi in China as the base of their beverages. It is then blended with modern flavours such as fresh milk and fresh fruits to brew unique, exquisite, aromatic and delicious fresh tea beverages. “A sip of tea lingers, two sips come with a long aftertaste” serves as the purpose of founding the brand as they aspire to be the top unique and delicious fresh tea beverage brand.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 10.30am to 9.30pm Last order 9pm

name: Big Fish Small Fish
description: Indulge in the freshest seafood experience at Big Fish Small Fish, your ultimate destination for mouth-watering Fish & Chips and an array of delectable fish dishes. Our unique dining concept allows you to personalize your meal to suit your taste buds. At Big Fish Small Fish, we’re committed to serving only the finest, high-quality seafood, meats, and pastas that can be enjoyed exactly as you like it. And, we’re passionate about putting our own creative spin on classic seafood favourites, ensuring every visit is a delightful culinary adventure.

name: Bird Avenue
description: Discover a haven of classic comfort food at Bird Avenue. Whether you're looking for a quick lunchtime fix or some delightful dinner we've got you covered. From our Spring Chicken to our popular Mixed Grill to our delectable House Pastas, there's something to satisfy every craving. Join us and indulge in timeless flavors that define casual dining at its best.

name: Bober Tea
description: Bober Tea is a brand of artisan tea focused on providing affordable, high-quality and tasty blends of Tea with a hint of local flavour. Our founders had found on their travels abroad the various tastes of Taiwanese, Japanese and Chinese Bubble teas that are vastly superior and have brought back the best of both worlds to Singapore - fusion of quality overseas teas and high grade bobas.

name: Boon Lay Power Nasi Lemak
description: Boon Lay Power Nasi Lemak is a highly sought after Nasi lemak in Singapore. The best and most tasty Nasi Lemak is a famous traditional Malay recipe that is served hot, just the way you like it.

name: Boost Juice
description: Boost Juice - the nation’s favourite makers of fresh smoothies and juices! We serve millions of Singaporeans our iconic green cups, filled with fruit and veggie deliciousness. Deliciousness that comes from simple, natural goodness, served to you with a love life attitude that will make you so happy you’ll probably end up high fiving random strangers. It’s about making healthy living easy!! So naturally, nutrition is a key component in developing our range of smoothies and juices that sees us blending through millions of tonnes of fruit and veggies every year.

name: BreadTalk
description: A staple in the diet of many in Asia, we honour the art of bread-making by giving life to novel creations since our inception in 2000. BreadTalk is a distinctive, award-winning Singaporean brand that has gained international appeal for its signature Flosss. With the belief that every bun has a life of its own and a story to tell, BreadTalk is renowned for the way it has revolutionised the culture of bread consumption with creativity and innovation. At the heart of our brand, Flosss is an iconic product that has become synonymous with BreadTalk. Our range of breads goes far beyond Flosss, with new and exciting products regularly added to our lineup.

name: BreadTalk
description: BreadTalk has brought about a renaissance in the bread business, with multiple awards testifying to its branding and business successes. Each BreadTalk bears the urban, clear glass, clean cut look punctuated subtly with detailing of contrasting colours of artworks, unique to each locale. The signature 'see thru' kitchens allow Chefs to showcase their expertise upfront, sharing the preparation of the freshly browned breads, each piece has a story to tell... so beautifully crafted, so heavenly in taste... BreadTalk's attention to detail does not stop here. The brand strives to stay ahead constantly, making every effort to improve your BreadTalk experience because they want your trip to BreadTalk to be as deliciously rewarding as the buns you select.

name: BreadTalk/Toast Box
description: BreadTalk has brought about a renaissance in the bread business, with multiple awards testifying to its branding and business successes. Each BreadTalk bears the urban, clear glass, clean cut look punctuated subtly with detailing of contrasting colours of artworks, unique to each locale. The signature 'see through' kitchens allow their chefs to showcase their expertise upfront, sharing the preparation of the freshly browned breads, each piece has a story to tell... so beautifully crafted, so heavenly in taste. Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.
opening_hours: BreadTalk: Monday to Friday 7.30am to 10.30pm Saturday, Sunday & PH 8am to 10.30pm Toast Box: Monday to Sunday 8am to 9.30pm

name: Chinatown Tan's TuTu Coconut Cake
description: The original Kueh Tutu was called “san” or light cake which came in the form of a large cake of rice flour without any filling and was steamed in trays. The kuehs consist of ground roasted peanuts or grated coconut with brown palm sugar fillings and this is unique to Singapore. The late Mr Tan Tuan Chiang learned about Kueh Tutu when he joined his father’s trade more than 50 years ago. The Tans’ push-carts were familiar sights in Chinatown then. To ensure that he prepares the perfect old-style Tutu Kuehs, he pounds whole rice grains to make rice flour. The purity of whole rice grains ensures that his cake is pure white. The flour is sifted many times so that the cakes are truly “san” or light. Finally the cake is filled and steamed before being served on a piece of fragrant pandan leaf. Handcrafted from start to end, this is truly a nostalgic snack that diners can’t skip.

description: Back in the 1990s, while our founder, a food connoisseur, was running a confectionery business in Taiwan, he was intrigued by the innovative combination of delicious milk teas and the chewy tapioca balls called boba in the street food markets. So he decided to bring bubble tea to Singapore and Each-a-Cup was established in 1999. Each-a-Cup was chosen because our founder desires for each and everyone to enjoy a special cup of tasty bubble tea, bringing them wellness benefi its at the same time. To achieve this mission, we have been endlessly pursuing product innovation and quality, striving to satisfy every of our customers. With market research backed by our Taiwan headquarters and carefully crafted flavors to suit Asia’s palate, we have come to lead in a new era largely defined by a lifestyle concern for health and wellness. Their mission is to do more than just serve food; they're here to ignite your senses, stir your memories, and create new ones. Our fresh seafood along with our seasonal produce and international selection are carefully hand-picked from all over the world to please even the most discerning palates. Not forgetting the health-conscious; they can take delight with our expanding range of prized organic items and fresh fruits. From the conventional to the epicurious, here is where you can celebrate the finest things in life.

Beyond the iconic crunchy cookie flavours you know and love, be spoilt with our range of chunky cookies, fluffy muffins, brownies and more. Need a smile, a perfect perk-me-up or the ideal gift for any special occasion? Our cookie gift items are the perfect treat to share with friends, family or simply indulge in yourself. name: Fire Ramen
description: Japanese Authentic Fire Ramen Experience from Kyoto Serving Full Courses from Appetisers, Mains (Ramen, Don, Sushi, Sashimi, Sumiyaki-Charcoal Grill), Sides, Beverages to Desserts & Alcohols. From native Kyoto, we are proud to bring Fire Ramen to Singapore. Experience it yourself with our fire-pouring chefs as they ignite the oil to create tall, dramatic flames, and pour it over their signature broth covered with Negi (green onions). The result is a unique flavor that can only be experienced at our restaurant. So come on down and try it for yourself!

name: Firefry
description: Craving something new? Fire Fry is here to excite your taste buds with delicious Thai snacks and satisfying bento meals. Whether you're on a lunch break or just looking for a tasty snack, Fire Fry serves up bold, authentic Thai flavours that hit the spot every time. Come and taste the tradition today!

name: Fish & Co.
description: Fish & Co. is a casual, family restaurant chain serving fresh seafood in a pan. This unique dining experience drew inspiration from the simple practices of the fishermen in the Mediterranean who caught seafood fresh from the seas, cooked and ate the freshly cooked seafood immediately from the pan. Designed with a casual, nautical ambience, Fish & Co. uses only the freshest fish and seafood, as well as natural ingredients like olive oil, herbs and various spices from around the world. Fish & Co. has been delighting customers with great tasting meals in generous portions and warm, friendly service - true marks of quality and value.

name: Fish & Co.
description: Established in 1998, Fish & Co. is a casual, family restaurant chain serving fresh seafood in a pan. This unique dining experience drew inspiration from the simple practices of the fishermen in the Mediterranean; who caught seafood fresh from the seas, cooked and ate the freshly cooked seafood immediately from the pan. Designed with a casual, nautical ambience, Fish & Co. restaurants, together with her friendly crew, are cheery, inviting and warm. At Fish & Co., all seafood is prepared in a simple and straightforward manner. Using only the freshest fish and seafood, as well as natural ingredients like olive oil, herbs and various spices from around the world, Fish & Co. has been delighting customers with great tasting meals in generous portions and warm, friendly service - true marks of quality and value.

name: Fluff Stack
description: fluff stack is run by pancake enthusiasts. They take pride in creating only the lightest, fluffiest stacks of goodness for their customers. Their pancakes are created with exact science – from choosing the right eggs, flour, and butter, to every fold of batter that we take –, but it is also so much more than that. They love the process, they love what they do, and they love their food. They hope this passion translates into your every bite.

name: Food Republic
description: With a total of 17 stalls and three mini-restaurants among its tenant mix, Food Republic at Causeway Point serves up endless options for foodies. The spacious food atrium with a breezy white garden concept features a light-coloured, airy and elegant design concept, giving diners a sense of serenity as they tuck into their meals.

name: Foodies’ Garden
description: Drawing upon a diverse spread of culinary cultures, Foodies’ Garden™ presents a variety of food and beverage brands housed under one roof. We aim to connect the community in setting that celebrates our culinary culture. From hawker favourites to international cuisines, a plethora of food awaits you.

name: Fore Coffee
description: In the pursuit of brewing the perfect cup, Fore Coffee is bringing the Indonesian coffee lifestyle to Singapore. As the pioneer that seeks to introduce what it means to enjoy coffee the Indonesian way, we promise to deliver more than just taste, but also a collection of stories brewed together into a solid experience. With Fore Coffee, embrace the evolving coffee culture as we redefine what it means to enjoy a cup of coffee, delivering the best Indonesia has to offer with our signature creations and innovations.

name: Fore Coffee
description: It starts with a simple desire: to bring better coffee, closer where you are. Now at The Centrepoint, you can find Fore Coffee serving premium blends crafted to match your pace, your taste, and your everyday moments. Since 2018, Fore Coffee has been on a journey to create exceptional coffee experiences for everyone. Inspired by the word "forest", our name reflects growth, connection, and a return to what grounds us. We believe great coffee starts with intention, using 100% high-quality Arabica beans, carefully sourced and locally roasted to bring out their fullest character. In the middle of life's rush, Fore Coffee is your pause - a space to slow down, take a sip, and reconnect with what truly matters. Because sometimes, all it takes is a good cup of coffee to remind you to Grind the Essentials.

name: Four Leaves
description: Established since 1981, Four Leaves has developed into one of the leading chain bakeries in Singapore. Walk into any Four Leaves bakery and you will be welcomed by the aroma of the freshly baked products, as well as getting spoilt for choice due to the wide variety that they offer.

description: Being the market leader in Singapore's durian industry, Four Seasons Durians take pride in providing customers with quality durian pastries by using only the freshest and most premium ingredients with no added sugar and preservatives. All products are locally handmade using 100% pure durian puree. They are vegetarian friendly and halal-certified.

name: Fruit Box
description: Fruit Box, with its pure quality, is the best nutritious partner for the city dweller! Providing 100% fresh fruit juices that are all-natural, containing phytonutrients; which are disease-fighting compounds and the healthiest beverage choice. Fruit Box only uses and purchase natural ingredients from reliable, and accredited suppliers who provide high-quality ingredients.

name: Fun Toast
description: Bringing back the traditional Nanyang Coffeehouse nostalgia, Fun Toast serves well-brewed fragrant local Coffee and Tea, deliciously fresh Yuan Yang Soft Bun, Ham & Cheese French Toast and many more. From uniquely Korean flavours like the Bulgogi Pizza to classic flavours like Pepperoni, you’re guaranteed to find one that you love!

name: Geláre
description: Geláre is a great place for a perfect meal at anytime of the day. We serve a variety ranging from hot western cuisine and light bites to desserts. Their specialty, freshly baked waffles, is paired with a wide selection of premium ice creams to be enjoyed by all.

name: Gochi-So Shokudo
description: Gochi-so Shokudo actively promotes a transparent, healthy eating practice from farm-to-table. The restaurant is dedicated to being an avenue for customers to enjoy all-natural pork.

name: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang
description: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang is a 100% local-owned brand that was established in 2017 to provide a unique Ma La cuisine experience while retaining the authenticity of the local fan favourite dish. GYMLT offer drinkable Ma La soup bases that do not leave a greasy or overwhelming aftertaste, so that customers can enjoy it till the very last drop. GYMLT understands that different people have different dietary needs and spice preferences. Hence, GYMLT offers other soup bases such as Mushroom, Pork bone, Tomato and Pickled Vegetable soup bases for those who do not enjoy spices We have also come up with a vegetarian friendly soup for our vegetarian consumers.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 10pm (9.30pm last order)

name: Gyushi
description: Our menu is inspired by the streets of Japan but made with local tastes in mind. Whether you’re a student looking for a quick lunch, a family dining out, or just craving something satisfying, Gyushi is your go-to destination for hearty, fuss-free meals served with a smile. From our signature Gyudon (beef bowl) to crispy karaage and plant-based options, there’s something for everyone at Gyushi. Each bowl is a balance of tradition, comfort, and creativity. Made fresh, fast, and always affordable.

name: HOT DUCK
description: Welcome to HOT DUCK, your go-to spot for a delicious twist on the classic corndog! They specialize in authentic Korean-style corndogs, freshly made just for you. At HOT DUCK, customization is key! Choose your core from our three delectable options: juicy pork, tender chicken, or melty cheese. Next, add your favorite toppings—select from sweet corn, crispy potato, or crunchy flakes for that perfect texture. Don’t forget to finish it off with a selection of mouthwatering sauces. Every corndog is crafted to order, ensuring a delightful experience with every bite. Come and explore the delicious world of Korean corndogs at HOT DUCK today!

name: HaiDiLao
description: HaiDiLao has always been dedicated to achieving the perfect blend of authentic traditional Chinese food - Hot Pot with the convenience of modern trend.

name: HaiDiLao Hot Pot
description: HaiDiLao has always been dedicated to achieving the perfect blend of authentic traditional Chinese food - Hot Pot with the convenience of modern trend.

name: Hakka Yu
description: Founded in 2013, Hakka Yu (客语) is a celebrated name in Hakka cuisine with over 80 locations across China and a legacy spanning more than 20 years. Dedicated to preserving authentic Hakka flavours, Hakka Yu merges traditional, natural cooking techniques with fresh, regionally sourced ingredients, delivering the rich, mountain-inspired flavours of Hakka culture to urban diners. Through continuous innovation, Hakka Yu reinterprets classic Hakka dishes with a contemporary flair, broadening its appeal while ensuring its legacy of quality endures in both domestic and international markets. Hakka Yu’s commitment to culinary excellence has earned it multiple accolades, including recognition among China’s Top 100 Restaurant Brands (2019-2020), designation as a Guangzhou Culinary Landmark (2021-2024), and a spot on Dianping’s prestigious "Must-Eat List" (2022 and 2024).

name: Han's
description: With more than 25 outlets islandwide, Singaporeans have come to love Hans, a place where you can tuck into Han's signature dish and a whole range of quality menus at reasonable prices in a comfortable environment.

name: Hanis Café & Bakery
description: Hanis Café & Bakery, the halal sister company of Han's Café & Cake House was incorporated in 2006 offering affordable food and pastries to a broader market. The food menu consists of Western Set Meal, Pasta dishes, Local Favourites and Hainanese signatures such as Chicken Curry and Chicken Stew.

name: Haruyama Udon®
description: Haruyama Udon ® - “Spring Mountain Udon”, specialises in Artisan Udon that is handmade daily. We offer an authentic taste of Japan, featuring 4 Artisan Udon from all around Japan. Our commitment to quality is reflected in our daily handmade Udon, ensuring a dining experience that truly captures the essence of Japanese culinary tradition.

name: Hawkers Street
description: Hawkers’ Street is a concept created to bring all of our favourite and famed hawkers, including Michelin-accredited brands nearer to all Singaporeans to ensure the continuity of our hawker dining habits by placing them under one roof.

name: Heavenly Wang
description: Established in 1953, Heavenly Wang is Singapore's No.1 Halal-Certified Asian Cafe, offering the same great taste traditional kopi and toast coupled with local asian favourites including noodles and savoury curry rice to satisfy your cravings from day to night.
opening_hours: Sunday to Thursday : 8am - 9pm Friday, Saturday & PH Eve : 8am - 9:30pm

name: Henri Charpentier
description: A french-inspired cafe and patisserie serving the best fresh cakes in Singapore. We offer a wide range of delicious fresh cakes (slices and whole), freshly baked financiers which are available in assorted flavours and much more.

name: Ho Kee Pau
description: Established in 1994, Ho Kee Pau is a Chinese traditional bun manufacturer which has grown from a small food stall to a food and snacks chain. With 14 outlets island-wide, it sells traditional pau, dim sum, congee and other local fare. Ho Kee Pau aims to serve customers with the best quality food at affordable prices.

name: Ho Kee Pau
description: Established in 1994, Ho Kee Pau is a Chinese traditional bun manufacturer which has grown from a small food stall to a food and snacks chain. name: Hockhua Herbal Tea
description: Enjoy Hockhua Herbal Tea’s specialties – a variety of bottled Herbal Tea and beverage made from ingredients such as luohan fruit, chrysanthemum and many more. Hockhua Herbal Tea produces herbal drinks every day to ensure what our customers get is fresh and of excellent quality, allowing everyone to easily enjoy these healthy concoctions without taking long hours to prepare them.

name: Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart
description: Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart has been all the rage in South East Asia since June 2016. Originating from Hokkaido, our resident bakers worked with counterparts from Hokkaido, Japan to further improve the recipe of this baked pastry to ensure a uniqueness in taste and texture. The soft and creamy centre is made with a blend of three different types of specialty cheeses, piped into a crunchy shortcrust pastry base. Tasting best when it is right out of the oven, the Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart also taste awesome when chilled, giving you a smooth and refreshing experience. When frozen, the tart is alike a creamy cheesy ice cream. Try all the ways of eating it and decide which one you like best! Apart from the delicious original flavour, we now have the decadent chocolate and the King of Fruits, Durian.

name: Hong Kong Egglet / Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specializes in traditional handmade pau from the authentic traditional recipe of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in house.

name: Hong Lim Curry Puff
description: Welcome to the Hong Lim Curry Puff - made with fresh and high quality ingredients served piping hot, where you’ll experience the finest and most delicious curry puffs in town. Their secret recipe has been passed down through generations, ensuring that every bite is filled with authentic flavors that will transport you to the streets of Singapore. From the flaky pastry to the perfectly spiced fillings, each curry puff is made with love and care, using only the freshest ingredients. Whether you’re looking for a quick snack or a satisfying meal, their curry puffs are sure to satisfy your cravings. So come on down to Best Curry Puff in Singapore and taste the difference!

name: Hot Tomato
description: Hot Tomato Cafe & Grill is a modern contemporary restaurant that serves steak, seafood, sides and pasta. They value their customers and prioritise quality food and service. For the celebration of special occasions or a simple meal with family and friends, they have dishes ready for your enjoyment at their outlets.

name: Hototogisu Ramen
description: Michelin-starred Hototogisu Ramen was founded in 2006 by Chef Atsushi Yamamoto in Tokyo, Japan. Achieving the honour of being awarded the prestigious One Michelin Star for two years in a row in the Tokyo Michelin Guide 2019 and 2020, it has been a journey for a ramen shop which started out as a humble 8-seater. Never resting on his laurels, Chef Yamamoto has once again created an exceptional concept for his 8th shop at Waterway Point. Debuting his “Bubble Soup”, the signature Porcini Cappuccino Ramen and Yuzu Cappuccino Ramen features a light and foamy Porcini and Yuzu sauce resembling the foam cap of a cappuccino.

name: I Love Taimei
description: I Love Taimei is a local F&B brand established with a passion and goal to share the best of Taiwanese street food culture with the world. The brand features well known Taiwan delicacies such as Taiwan Fried Chicken, Braised Chicken Rice (Lu Rou Fan), Fried Snacks such as Taiwan Tempura and Bubble Tea.

name: Ichiban Boshi
description: Ichiban Boshi introduces Japanese dining with a dash of modern simplicity offering the best premium quality sushi, sashimi, seafood and a variety of set meals. With an emphasis on quality, Ichiban Boshi is proud to present premium Japanese cuisine at reasonable prices right throughout the year.
opening_hours: Monday to Friday 11.30am to 10pm Saturday, Sunday & PH 11am to 10pm

Select from our extensive range of all-time favorite set meals and end your meal with a sweet treat like delicious mochi, coronets and chocolate mousse.
opening_hours: Monday to Thursday 11.30am to 10pm Friday to Sunday 11am to 10pm

name: Ji Xiang Kueh
description: Since 1988, Ji Xiang Ang Ku Kueh is a Singaporean brand which specializes and preserves the traditional Chinese pastry called Ang Ku Kueh. The name Ang Ku Kueh is translated “Red Turtle Cake”, which symbolizes prosperity, longevity and wealth.

name: Jollibee
description: Jollibee is the Philippines’ largest food chain, operating a network of more than 1,100 stores worldwide. A dominant market leader in the Philippines, Jollibee has embarked on an accelerated international expansion plan, now with over 230 international stores in 16 countries. Its world-famous crispylicious, juicylicious Chickenjoy has earned the praise of the late chef Anthony Bourdain, was touted as the best fried chicken in Hong Kong by South China Morning Post, and praised by Foodbeast, a popular US-based food publication.

description: Jollibee is famous across the world since 1978 for delicious crispy Fried Chicken and other comfort food including pies, beef spaghetti, burgers and many more. Try our world famous Chickenjoy fried chicken or our Chicken sandwich and you’ll understand why they bring joy to so many people! There is nothing like eating food with joyfulness with the ones you love.

name: KAZO
description: KAZO® (卡滋屋) is a patisserie bakery specializing in Taiwanese premium handmade baked goods. From Crispy Cream Puff, Signature Polo Bun to Baked Cheese Tart, KAZO values freshness, quality, simplicity, and, of course, taste. With a rigorous ingredient selection and product creation process, they put all their love and passion into the oven, baking fresh every day.

name: KFC
description: Captivating aroma, succulent juicy chicken and thoughtful service are what KFC lovers come back for. Choose between our signature Original Recipe chicken prepared with Colonel Sander's secret blend of 11 herbs & spices, or the all-time favourite Hot & Crispy chicken. Check out the perennially popular KFC a.m. Breakfast menu and the variety of food items from Rice to Egg Tarts as well. Visit KFC today for an experience that is so good.

name: KOI Thé
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

description: KILLINEY 1919: A Taste of Heritage Singapore's oldest Hainanese coffee shop is now open at Tampines 1 Mall! Savour our iconic traditional Kopi and Kaya Toast, alongside beloved Asian classics. Serving tradition, since 1919

name: Kopi & Tarts
description: “Kopi & Tarts” is a new local Halal coffee concept by Mayson Bakery, where we marry the love of coffee with our freshly baked tarts and pastries. opening_hours: Monday to Wednesday 7am to 10pm Thursday to Sunday 7am to 2am

name: Krispy Kreme

name: Lead General Hot Pot
description: In 1980, in Chongqing's Ciqikou, the Shuai family's old stove began crafting a legacy. Master Shuai pioneered the "Three Simmerings and Nine Brewings" beef tallow recipe, paired with the ancestral Nine-Square Grid technique, creating a hotpot known for its rich, layered flavors. The second-generation heir brought this tradition to New York, where the aroma of Chongqing hotpot became a nostalgic symbol for many. Now, he heads to the Lion City, launching "Lead General" hotpot in May 2025, blending century-old techniques with Southeast Asian influences. From Ciqikou to Manhattan, and now to Singapore, "Lead General" aims to share the essence of Chinese hotpot with the world. With a copper pot and a blend of spices, we embark on a journey to let the world savor the timeless flavors of China.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 10pm (Last order at 9.30pm)

Brown Sugar Pearl, Avocado and Fruit Tea are what LiHO does best and it is the heart of our brand.” Great emphasis is placed on the entire process, from choosing the right tea to roasting, to brewing and finally serving it.

Whether you're in the mood for a light bite or a satisfying snack, Old Chang Kee is your go-to stop for local delights.

name: Old Tea Hut
description: At Old Tea Hut, we brew fresh all day long, just for you. Our love for fine tea blends, rich coffee roast and tantalising beverages start our dedication to bringing you an exciting gastronome menu experience. We offer different flavours of tea and coffee beverages from time-honoured traditional drinks to original Old Tea Hut creations, as well as flavourful alternative beverages. So whatever your preference is, we’ll have the right beverage to tantalize your taste buds! We welcome you to discover and enjoy a taste of Old Tea Hut today.

name: Otter Pizza
description: Concept conceived in 2019, Otter Pizza aims to provide a wider variety of quality pizza choices with an affordable price tag to fellow Singaporean in heartland areas. Relying on their expertise in supply chain management and high efficiency achieved from centralized operation, Otter Pizze believe quality can be affordable. Otter Pizza position themselves as a “Neighbourhood Pizzeria” that welcomes repeated visits with family members, friends, couples, and more, throughout their daily lives.

name: Ottie Pancakes
description: Ottie Pancakes brings you the beloved traditional Min Jiang Kueh (MJK ) , also known as Apam Balik, with a delightful modern twist. At Ottie Pancakes, we serve soft, fluffy pancakes in a variety of unique flavors that cater to both traditional and adventurous taste buds. Every bite is crafted to deliver "Sweet Moments in Every Bite", combining nostalgia with a fresh, irresistible twist. Whether you love the classic fillings or are looking to explore new flavours, Ottie Pancakes promises a satisfying treat for everyone!

name: PUTIEN
description: PUTIEN serves cuisine from the Fujian Province in China: characteristically light, down-to-earth, and flavourful food with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. Signatures like Fujian Red Mushroom Seafood Lor Mee, ‘100-Second’ Stewed Yellow Croaker and PUTIEN Bian Rou Soup showcase the culinary richness of Fujianese cuisine that will fill your stomach and heart.

name: PUTIEN MAMA
description: PUTIEN MAMA welcomes you with a selection of PUTIEN favourites at everyday locations and prices. Just as mamas are the heartbeat of every family, we care for you with comfort food made from fresh, best-quality ingredients. From savoury, flavourful lor mee to our signature bee hoon made with fine, translucent vermicelli, authentic Heng Hwa recipes are served fresh, hot, and fast with a mama’s touch.

name: Paik's Noodle
description: Bringing you hot favourites such as Jajangmyeon, Jjamppong & Tangsuyuk by South Korean Celebrity Chef Paik Jong Won! Known in its homeland as “Hong Kong Banjeom 0410,” Paik’s Noodle is a culinary hotspot launched in 2006, in Seoul to provide the best flavours, recipes, and sauces by sustaining the real essence of a Korean Chinese restaurant. Paik's Noodle serves a variety of authentic Korean-Chinese dishes like Jjamppong (a hot, flavourful seafood noodle soup), and Paik’s Signature Tangsuyuk (crispy sweet and sour pork) with both being perfect options for sharing with friends or family. Spicy food lovers will love the spice in Jjamppong while kids would love the sweetness and crispness from Tangsuyuk.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 9pm (8:30pm last order)

name: Papa Ayam
description: Established in 2018 with a food kiosk concept, Papa Ayam deliver the fusion of crispy fried chicken with Indonesian authentic sambal. Ayam (Chicken) and Geprek (Smashed or Crashed) served with traditionally-made original sambal on mortar and pestle that you can choose your spicy level from Level 1 – level 15! Papa Ayam assure you the freshness of the sambal as it is made on the spot according to your spice level. Apart from that, they also serve Sambal Matah (Balinese sambal) and Cabe Ijo (green chilli).

name: Paris Baguette
description: Paris Baguette, born in 1988, is a global bakery brand of SPC Group, a leading South Korean food and confectionery corporation. From its modest beginnings, the chain has grown steadily to become the No.1 bakery in Korea. From 2004, the brand has expanded internationally, the brand operates around 4,000 stores worldwide across the United States, Canada, France, UK, China and Southeast Asia, solidifying its reputation as a truly global premium bakery brand. Paris Baguette is committed to blending traditional baking techniques with modern innovation to deliver diverse range of products such as breads, pastries, cakes, and beverages that appeal to a wide audience, from everyday treats to special celebration.

name: Paris Baguette
description: Born from a love of bread and a passion for quality, Paris Baguette is an international, fast-casual bakery founded in 1988 specialized in French-inspired baked goods offering chef-inspired cakes, pastries, freshly made sandwiches and salads with signature coffee and tea. Paris Baguette aims to offer a unique experience to thousands of guests daily.

Each shape is thoughtfully selected so as to hold the ideal amount of sauce and to provide the best mouthfeel.
opening_hours: Sunday to Thursday 11.30am to 8.30pm Friday & Saturday 11.30am to 9pm

description: PastaMania is the largest halal-certified Italian casual dining chain in Singapore offering a diverse range of pastas. From Italian classics like Prawn Aglio and Carbonara, to specially crafted fusion delights like Seafood Tom Yum, Otah Aglio and even pizzas, there’s something for everyone!

description: Pepper Lunch is a DIY fast service concept, with more than 200 outlets in Japan and Asia. Pepper Lunch promises a dynamic and fresh culinary experience for everyone by presenting the novel concept of sizzling Steaks, Pastas, Curry Rice, and not forgetting their signature Pepper Rice. All at affordable prices!

From its vibrant updated interior to pizzas that transport tastebuds across continents. Pezzo is back, this time with a new flavourful evolution elevating its signature fun-loving spirit that we’ve all come to know and love.

The French Roast Chicken maestro serves freshly roasted chicken that are brined overnight using an in-house secret recipe. The Poulet Roti is complemented with 4 signature sauces, they create a perfect symphony for the signature dish. Poulet presents itself as the perfect place for any occasion worth celebrating, with something for everyone to savour and indulge in.

description: PrimaDéli serves all-time favourites that everyone loves and enjoys. description: Established in 1992, PrimaDéli is Singapore's first home-grown halal bakery franchise and a leading brand for high-quality cakes, pastries, breads, and other baked goods. name: Ramen Hitoyoshi
description: Ramen Hitoyoshi specializes in serving one of the world’s most popular dishes, Tonkotsu Ramen. Tonkotsu Ramen comes with a rich and thick broth, coupled with home-made Chashu, noodles, Ajitama (flavoured egg), and other fresh ingredients, making it flavourful and extremely palatable.

name: Red Ginger
description: Red Ginger is the creation of a dedicated team of food lovers, having decades of experience in the F&B industry. It first started operating at IMM Building since 2000, gaining a strong presence in the West region of Singapore through serving a remarkable spread of Nasi Padang dishes. Red Ginger's niche expertise lies in halal cuisine with a modern twist, dedicated to bringing top-notch fare to customers at affordable prices. A strong focus on its traditional cooking methods of Nasi Padang complemented with authentic local wok dishes ensures a gastronomical experience that must not be missed!

name: Red Ginger Coffeehouse
description: Red Ginger Coffeehouse is the evolved expression of our beloved culinary journey, crafted by a passionate team of food enthusiasts with over two decades of experience in the F&B industry. Building on the legacy of Red Ginger & Rumah Sayang, we now bring a fresh and modern take to our cherished Malaysian and local Singaporean favorites. We have been dedicated to delivering authentic halal cuisine with an elevated touch—offering a nuanced blend of tradition and contemporary culinary refinement. Our focus remains on signature dishes like Nasi Padang and local wok specialties, prepared using traditional techniques with a modern presentation and improved service that elevates your dining experience. Red Ginger Coffeehouse is where familiar flavors meet modern sophistication—offering slightly higher quality ingredients and a welcoming ambiance that invites you to indulge without the high-end price tag. Join us to rediscover classic tastes, reimagined for today’s discerning palate.

name: Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine
description: Experience the rich, slow-cooked flavours of Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine, where hearty claypot dishes take centre stage. Savour signature Claypot Grilled Qing Jiang Fish in Green Pepper Sauce, Beef Brisket with Potato and Radish, or Tomato Salt Baked Chicken, each meticulously prepared to perfection. The menu also features many other flavourful claypots and a selection of other Cantonese dishes, perfect for enjoying hot, comforting meals.

name: Robochef
description: Robochef will offer a choice of 17 dishes of familiar Singapore favourites, cooked to perfection in mere minutes. Tapping on local culinary experts to fine tune the recipes to local Singapore tastes, Robochef will offer customers delicious food at affordable prices. The unique use of AI allows a perfect blending of ingredients, seasoning and the optimization of cooking times.

name: S.O.S Chicken by Wine Connection
description: S.O.S Chicken is on a mission to unite various flavours and fragrances on a staple dish - a tender, juicy charcoal-grilled chicken, served with an array of Stand Out Sauce (S.O.S) to reflect Singapore's diverse culinary scene! A simple pairing, yet can be enjoyed in various ways depending on your craving or mood. Get sossy with an array of sauces and sides that are inspired by cuisines from all around the world.

name: SEOUL NOODLE SHOP
description: SEOUL NOODLE SHOP is an Authentic Korean handcrafted knife-cut noodles restaurant prepared with traditional techniques. Following the proverb "All good things come to Seoul," SEOUL NOODLE SHOP aims to offer the best noodles in Korea. From the noodle dough to the broth and kimchi, every food is meticulously prepared and served. Skilled artisans create firm, chewy noodles, while the broth, brewed with great care, adds depth and flavor to the knife-cut noodles. Handmade dumplings and kimchi are also available to accompany the meal. At SEOUL NOODLE SHOP, you can savor the authentic taste of Korean food made with dedication and using time-honored techniques.

name: SF Fruits & Juices
description: SF started off with its first outlet in Orchard Road in 2004 selling cut fruits and juices. They now have around 30 outlets island wide with some selling whole fruits as well. SF strives to provide quality fruits and farm produce to all at affordable prices.

Renowned for its lightning-fast, friendly and energetic service, SUKIYA uplifts and energizes its customers around the world by providing a truly authentic Japanese experience to all.

description: Sakon Thai serves authentic Thai food with light customization to suit the local taste. The food concept combines flavors from the original Sakon Town located in Northeast Thailand and the Gau Yuak Temple in Chiang Mai. The founder has been a regular donor to the temple and has stayed there for some time. He was so impressed by the dishes cooked by the locals for the temple visitors and has since brought these special flavors to Singapore, in 2008 opening the first Sakon Thai in Serangoon North. Today if you visit Sakon Thai you can taste these special recipes in the dishes like the Fried Fish Red & Green Sauce and the Sambal fried kanggong.

name: Shi Li Fang Hot Pot & One Pot
description: At 热辣滚烫 One Pot, we bring you Ma La Tang and Ma La Ban with a local twist! Our delicious broth is packed with rich flavors, and our wide selection of fresh ingredients lets you create the perfect bowl, just the way you like it. Whether you prefer soup or dry mix, mild or bold flavors, there’s something for everyone. Pair it with crispy fried toppings and silky scrambled eggs for an unforgettable meal. Shi Li Fang Hot Pot has become the most economical hot pot restaurant chain that provides the widest range of dishes and sauces in Singapore. They have successfully created a healthy Singapore centric hot pot through careful food selection according to Singapore's multi- ethnicity, suitable for all demographics. Committed to share their hot pot creations to all, they will continue to expand and reach everyone here in Singapore.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food
description: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food® is everybody's favorite Taiwanese food chain featuring popular snacks from the alleys of Taiwan's night markets. Prepared the way they do over in Taiwan, the menu features authentic favorites such as XXL Crispy Chicken, Crispy Floss Egg Crepe, Handmade Oyster Mee Sua and Seafood Tempura.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food

Prepared the way they do over in Taiwan, the menu features authentic favorites such as XXL Crispy Chicken, Crispy Floss Egg Crepe, Handmade Oyster Mee Sua and Seafood Tempura.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks
description: Thousands of Taiwanese crowd the local nightmarkets in search of their favorite and delicious snacks, and Taipei’s Shihlin Night Market is the most famous due to its very wide range of local delicacies in its small streets and alleys. If a snack is nice, you can surely find it in Shihlin! The locals say, “If Taiwan has it, Shihlin has it.” With Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks®, the Taiwanese and us alike can now do the same and enjoy the wonderful street snacks of Taiwan!

name: Shine Korea

name: Snackz It!
description: Snackz It! Is a brands created in Singapore and establishes in 2005 selling creative street cuisine. Our business has grown over the years and we now boast a presence beyond Singapore. We are committed to bringing our customers the tastiest street food, using the freshest ingredients and most dedicated service. We want you to enjoy our food and we are obsessed with getting them right for you.

name: So Do Fun
description: Specializing in "Boiled Live Fish" as its signature dish, SO DO FUN is a popular Sichuan restaurant chain renowned for its "fresh ingredients prepared on-site." With just this one handcrafted boiled live fish dish, it has remained popular for 18 years, operating nearly 100 direct stores across China, Singapore, and Malaysia. For years, it has consistently ranked among the top three on regional Sichuan cuisine lists and dominated as the No. 1 popular Sichuan brand in various markets. It was listed on the "Dianping Must-Eat List" in 2018 and 2023. For 18 years, SODOFUN has used fresh ingredients.

name: So Do Fun
description: So Do Fun Sichuan Cuisine was founded in 2007 and is renowned for its signature dish — Boiled Live Fish. We use fresh, live ingredients prepared daily on-site, bringing the authentic taste of Sichuan to every table. For 18 years, So Do Fun has remained one of the most beloved Sichuan restaurants, consistently ranking as a top choice on local food charts. Today, we operate nearly 100 outlets across China, Singapore, and Malaysia, serving over one million bowls of boiled fish annually.

description: TORI-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated “Tare” (sauce) for enhanced flavours.

name: Tai Cheong Bakery
description: Tai Cheong Bakery was started in 1954 by egg tart Master Au Yeung’s uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. After taking over Tai Cheong Bakery, Au Yeung pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts, refining several other recipes using techniques he learned from his previous work in a hotel baking cakes. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street. The popularity of Tai Cheong remains till today.

name: Tai Chong Kok
description: At Tai Chong Kok, we have been making mooncakes and traditional Cantonese pastries the same way since 1935 - from scratch and by hand. For 3 generations we have used only premium ingredients to produce our authentic Cantonese confectionary. Tai Chong Kok mooncakes are renowned for their genuine taste of tradition. We are one of the very few bakeries left in Singapore that still produce our fresh lotus paste by hand using 100% pure lotus seeds with no preservatives added and these fill mooncakes that are formed in the same traditional wooden moulds used at the original Sago Street store in Chinatown more than 89 years ago. Today, you can still bring home our mooncakes in stringed brown paper bags, just as our forefathers did in pre-war Singapore. Tai Chong Kok is also famed for our traditional Nian Gao (Chinese New Year's cake) that are made using 100% pure glutinous rice. Tai Chong Kok products are handmade and baked daily with no preservative added in Singapore using time-honoured recipes and quality ingredients with full conformity to Stringent Quality Standards of SFA, HACCP and BizSafe.

We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest pork from renowned farms in Japan and around the world, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavour in every dish. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every cut of pork we serve maintains the highest standards of quality and flavour. Our skilled chefs meticulously prepare each tonkatsu dish to perfection, using airy, light, and crispy panko (bread crumbs) imported from Saitama Prefecture of Japan for that delightful texture. Whether you're indulging in our tonkatsu or exploring our diverse menu of signature dishes like the A4/A5 Miyazaki gyukatsu, black curry ramen, sandos, or a simple take-out bento, expect a culinary journey celebrating the rich and complex flavours of Japanese cuisine

name: Tonkatsu by Ma Maison
description: Ma Maison, which is French for “my house”, is one of the most well-loved restaurant chain offering Western- Japanese fusion cuisine. One of the main draws is its irresistibly good pork cutlet—available as Rosu (pork loin) Katsu or the leaner Hire (pork fillet) Katsu—which undergoes an aging and marinating process before it is breaded and deep-fried. The pork cutlets are served in sets with rice, shredded cabbage, and tonjiru (miso soup with pork) and pickles—all refillable. To enjoy the best of both land and sea, order the premium Unagi Tonkatsu Kamado Set comprising premium charcoal-grilled unagi from Isshiki in Aichi prefecture, kamado- style rice cooked in a traditional Japanese earthen pot, pickles, nyumen (soup noodles) and a choice of Rosu or Hire Katsu.

name: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen
description: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen is a popular authentic Japanese hot stone ramen with an entertaining twist, with portions and a variety of menu good for sharing and for fun family dining. The dish is prepared in a 350°C hot stone bowl, where thick noodles and vegetables are placed before hot soup is poured over them, creating a dramatic steam effect that resembles a volcanic eruption. The " Okoge "  that forms when ingredients touch the hot stone, adds a fragrant aroma and delightful texture.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 10pm (Last Order at 9.30pm)

name: Tori-Q
description: Tori-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated "Tare" (sauce) for enhanced flavour.
opening_hours: Sunday to Thursday 10.30am to 9pm Friday, Saturday & PH 10.30am to 9.30pm

description: Satisfy your sweet-tooth cravings with these elegant-looking treats housed in their signature pink boxes. Choose from over 40 flavours of gourmet cupcakes at Twelve Cupcakes. description: Twenty Loaf Toasties serves made-to-order grilled toasts loaded with fresh ingredients! Try our signature Cheesy Bakkwa Toasties: generous portions of sweet and savoury Chicken Bakkwa and Floss.

name: Wanglu Hot Pot
description: Wanglu Hot Pot is a steamboat restaurant that allows every customers to have their own pot for cooking. Its vision is to offer high quality food and service to customers of all ages. With a focus on hygiene and a comfortable dining environment, along with a wide variety of soup bases, Wang Lu will definitely satisfy your hot pot cravings.

name: Warabimochi Kamakura
description: Explore Warabimochi Kamakura for a genuine slice of Japan with their exquisite Warabimochi and creative Warabimochi Drinks. Each offering is a contemporary take on classic tastes, designed for the sophisticated palate. Warabimochi Kamakura provides a distinctive gastronomic adventure where tradition blends with modernity. Experience the fusion of time-honoured flavours and innovative craftsmanship with every visit.

name: Wen Zhang Lao Mian
description: Wen Zhang Lao Mian, a specialist in noodle making and soup development, was established in China in 2017. Over the years, our brand has become well-known. Our goal is to provide a unique dining experience and a comforting atmosphere for all our customers. Among our most beloved noodle dishes are Spicy Beef Noodle, Tomato Soup with Fried Pork, Herbal Soup with Braised Pork, Soup Spicy Fish, and Golden Fish Soup. In addition to noodles, we offer a variety of fried rice, Chinese dishes, and enticing desserts.

name: White Restaurant
description: Welcome to White Restaurant, home to The Original Sembawang White Beehoon – an iconic truly-Singaporean delicacy, alongside renowned dishes like Hainanese Chicken Rice and Chilli Crab. Our founder, Mr Tay, originally crafted this comforting dish, which has since captured the hearts of many. The Original Sembawang White Beehoon stands out with its exceptional flavours and distinctiveness. It has earned its own identity and holds a special place in the hearts of food enthusiasts. While many have tried to imitate our signature dish, none can match its unparalleled taste. That’s why we have rebranded ourselves as White Restaurant, symbolizing the heritage and uniqueness of The Original White Beehoon.

name: Wingstop
description: Serving the World Flavour through an unparalleled guest experience and offering of classic wings, boneless wings and tenders, always cooked to order and hand-sauced-and-tossed in fans’ choice of 10 bold, distinctive flavours, including fans’ favourite Kecap Manis that is exclusive to Singapore. Wingstop’s menu also features signature sides including seasoned fries, hand-breaded mushroom fritters and freshly-made ranch dip.

Dive into a world of savory delights at WOK The Fish! and savor the essence of the sea in every spoonful.

name: XW Plus Western Grill
description: Being the western casual dining place, XW Western Grill is your one-stop for all things grilled. Offering a line-up of smoky favourites such as steaks, chicken and fish, the combination of mouth-watering natural juices and charred flavours are perfect for insatiable palates. Our all-you-can-eat salad bar boasting unlimited servings of hot and cold sides won’t disappoint either, it comes free with any main course order or go straight for the à la carte salad bar. Kick back and enjoy western grub in this vibrant value-for-money diner – a perfect avenue for gatherings with family and friends.

name: YAYOI
description: YAYOI is a Japanese Teishoku Restaurant. They serve "Teishoku" which includes a good balance of steamed rice (Japanese staple food), miso soup, main dish, side dish and other items on a tray. YAYOI will pass down Japan's delicious food to the future and spread it to the world.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 8am to 9pm (Last Order at 8.30pm)

description: 49 Seats has been in F&B industry for 5 years and has established a strong local presence. It is recognised for the fusion style meals with a slight twist of local flavour. Other main courses like Fish & Chips with alscampi or tom yum sauce is infused with our special sauce and ingredients that leaves one craving for more. Having a strong branding concept is our forte which focus on unique interior that features an old coffee shop metal gate. Founded on the belief of creating a friendly and fun environment, 49 Seats offers a casual dining experience that continue to serve quality food to the guest's heart. With a price that is comfortably affordable to all, customers get to enjoy our fusion food at anytime of the day & late night.

description: 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles is the predecessor of the Fei Siong Group as the original stall in Redhill Close belonged to the grandfather of Mr Tan Kim Siong, the managing director of Fei Siong Group. This is now a chain of speciality food establishments in suburban malls and city centre malls comprising 6 specialty restaurants and 1 stall located at Fei Siong at Tangs Market. As the name may suggest, it specialises in teochew style fishball noodles with nostalgic flavour and taste. At 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles, you will savour tasty noodles with good texture served with delicious hand made teochew fishball, meatball and fishcake all made from yellow tail fish. The fishballs are often described as being light and bouncy but dense in flavours. Once inside any 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles outlet, you will get to enjoy this well-loved local fare in a comfortable and cosy setting thereby greatly enhancing your dining experience at 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles.

description: Rooted in the rustic and traditional cowboy theme, ANDES by ASTONS brings the best quality and value-for-money steaks and other western fare to you. Being halal-certified and MUIS-accredited, ANDES is the answer to the calling of our Muslim friends for scrumptious and affordable steaks and western cuisine in Singapore. An alter-ego of ASTONS Specialities, where the menu is almost identical, ANDES uses the same high quality and fresh ingredients to serve up generous portions of food to our customers. The main menu consists of a wide selection of steak cuts, chicken and seafood with most main courses served with two side dishes of your choice, cold or hot. At ANDES, you can definitely find something that suits your palate. Great food at great prices with a great atmosphere, what more could you ask for?

name: ASTONS Steak & Salad
description: Astons brand established itself as a household name, synonymous with quality and affordability. The introduction of Astons Steak & Salad was the result of fulfilling a better commitment to all customers. This restaurant features Astons in a Steak & Salad bar concept where there are over 80 selections of all-you-can-eat salads at the bar including home-made soup, fresh greens and dessert. Our menu boasts a variety of main courses including our signature steaks, which comes with buffet serving at the salad bar. Other items on the menu include seafood entree, grilled chicken and kids meal. The restaurant is simply designed to give a pleasant and private atmosphere with jazz music in the background. It will be a place for all occasions. At Astons, it is a quality and value for money concept.
opening_hours: Monday to Thursday Lunch: 11.30am to 3pm Dinner: 5pm to 10pm Friday to Sunday & PH 11.30am to 10pm

name: Aburi-EN
description: Specialised in quality Japanese grilled meats. Aburi-EN offers a variety of high-quality donburi (rice bowls) at affordable prices in a comfortable and affable ambiance. Aburi-EN takes pride in its homemade umami-packed meat sauce, as well as the high-quality imported pork and the A4/A5 Miyazaki Wagyu it uses which has won Japan’s “National Wagyu Award” four consecutive times. At Aburi-EN, you can enjoy the best of Japanese drinking culture with an extensive selection of highballs, beers, shochu and sake that complements the array of grilled meats. Focusing on premium ingredients grilled to perfection and offered at affordable prices, it’s little wonder why Aburi-EN is a favourite amongst many.

name: Ajisen
description: Originating from Kumamoto Japan, Ajisen Ramen is famous for its white broth, made by simmering pork bones for many hours. Its Tonkotsu soup is rich in collagen, a protein which is good for the skin. Since 1968, Ajisen Ramen has strived to bring delicious and authentic ramen to people from all walks of life, serving young and old with our extensive ramen line-up.

name: Auntie Ashley
description: Rooted in the rich culinary heritage of Ipoh, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam brings the true taste of Malaysia’s most celebrated food town to the heart of Orchard, The Centrepoint. Inspired by the success of Choy Kee Bakery in Ipoh, this new outlet continues the same dedication to authenticity, tradition, and comfort food that generations have grown up loving. Every dish served is a tribute to Ipoh’s time-honoured kopitiam culture, where simple ingredients are elevated through craftsmanship, patience, and recipes passed down through generations. At the heart of the menu is our signature Nasi Ayam Goreng Berempah, marinated with over ten aromatic Malay spices and fried to golden perfection—crispy on the outside, juicy within, and deeply fragrant. Our Ipoh Hor Fun is another standout, made using rice noodles renowned for their silky smooth texture, a hallmark of Ipoh’s mineral-rich spring water. Served in comforting chicken broth or bold curry, each bowl delivers warmth, depth, and unmistakable authenticity. Complementing the mains are classic sides like Hainanese Chicken Chop Rice, Sizzling Hot Plate Claypot Noodles, and freshly prepared dim sum that recall the bustling kopitiams of old Ipoh. No Ipoh experience is complete without coffee. Our authentic Ipoh Chang Jiang White Coffee, roasted with butter for a smoother, richer aroma, stays true to the original Ipoh method, offering a nostalgic cup that pairs perfectly with Choy Kee Egg Tarts. From hearty rice dishes to nostalgic desserts and handcrafted drinks, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam is more than a meal — it is a comforting journey home, familiar yet exciting, for those who are seeking genuine Ipoh flavours in Singapore.

name: Awfully Chocolate

Or perhaps indulge in one of their more interesting concoctions - Soda Gembira (Happy Soda) and Teh Botol Sosro (Indonesian Bottled Jasmine Tea).
